title: Lehrer für hausinterne Beschulung (m/w/d) (Lehrer/in - Schularten der Sekundarstufe I)
description: Das „Gutsschloss Blossin“ ist eine in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland einzigartige Einrichtung, deren Leistungsportfolio Therapie, Sozialpädagogik und Schule verbindet.Unser qualifiziertes Team besteht aus Diplom-Psycholog*innen, Musik- und Kunsttherapeut*innen, Erzieher*innen, Lehrer*innen und anderen Mitarbeiter*innen in den Bereichen Küche, Haushalt und Hausmeisterei.Für unseren Bereich der stationären Jugendhilfe suchen wir für unser „Gutsschloss Blossin“ für die hausinterne Beschulung auf gymnasialem Niveau ab sofort eine engagierte Lehrkraft (d/w/m).Gehaltab 3.580 € pro Monat bei 32 Stunden in einer 4-Tage-Woche; bei entsprechender Berufserfahrung und höherer Qualifikation wird das Gehalt entsprechend angepasst; Steigerungen nach Betriebszugehörigkeit oder/und entsprechenden WeiterbildungenAnstellungsart- Festanstellung- TeilzeitSchichten und ArbeitszeitenDie Arbeitszeiten werden entsprechend den Strukturen der Einrichtung angepasst und sind von 7:30 - 16:00 Uhr.ArbeitsortGutsschloss Blossin, 15754 Heidesee - OT Blossin, Anger 7 (Nähe Wolziger See)Unsere Zusatzleistungen- Angemessene Vergütung in Anlehnung des TV-L- Zahlung einer vierteljährliche Gesundheitsprämie, wenn keine AU vorliegt- Spendit-Card nach erfolgreicher Probezeit- Stiftungsevents- Mitarbeiterjahresgespräche zur persönlichen Zielvereinbarung und Entwicklung- Monatliche Dienst- und Fallberatungen, Supervision- Tägliche Dienstübergaben- Flexible individuelle berufliche Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote u. ggf. finanzielle Unterstützung- Kostenlose Teilnahme an Mahlzeiten im Rahmen der Dienstzeiten.Ihre Aufgaben- Reintegration der Jugendlichen in das Regelschulsystem- Stabilisierung des Schulbesuchs und Vermeidung erneuter Schulabbrüche- Förderung schulischer Leistungen, sozialer Kompetenzen und Selbstwirksamkeit- Entwicklung realistischer schulischer und beruflicher Perspektiven gemeinsam mit dem pädagogischen Team- Teilnahme an den Dienstberatungen und -übergaben- Zusammenarbeit mit dem pädagogischen Team & den Sorgeberechtigten- Zusammenarbeit mit den bei uns zusätzlich unterrichtenden Lehrern des Schiller-Gymnasiums (Deutsch Mathe, Englisch) und mit den Schulämtern und unseren Kooperationsschulen- Sie verfügen über Wissen in den naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern (Bio, Chemie, Physik, Geografie, Geschichte...) und können dieses Wissen auch durch Unterricht vermitteln- Gewissenhafte Dokumentation der ArbeitIhre Qualifikation und Kompetenzen:- Sie verfügen mindestens über das 1. Stiftung und seine Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter Zugang zu Sonderkonditionen von zahlreichen Anbietern- Parkplätze vor dem Schloss- auf Wunsch besteht die Möglichkeit der Nutzung unserer hochwertigen Kajaks, die wir für die Freizeitaktivitäten der Jugendlichen angeschafft haben und nutzenWir begrüßen Ihre Bewerbung unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

title: Pädagogische oder pflegerische Fachkraft (m/w/d) für das geschützte Setting auf der Hangweide (Heilerziehungspfleger/in)
description: Machen auch Sie den Beruf zur Berufung und werden Sie Teil des Geschäftsbereichs Leben Wohnen Kernen .Als einer der größten Arbeitgeber für Care-Berufe in der Region Stuttgart schaffen wir die notwendigen Strukturen, damit Sie Ihren Beruf bestmöglich ausüben und dabei selbst vorankommen können – sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich.Wir bringen Inklusion ins Leben und begleiten Menschen kompetent und mit Herz. Die Gruppen im geschützten Setting auf der Hangweide sind Wohnangebote für erwachsene Menschen mit Behinderung und herausforderndem Verhalten. Die Verhaltensauffälligkeiten zeigen sich durch Beeinträchtigungen aus den Bereichen des Autismus-Spektrums, der Kommunikation, der Affektsteuerung und des Zwanges. Ziel der fachlichen Begleitung im geschützten Setting ist es, Strukturen und Strategien zur Alltags- und Krisenbewältigung zu entwickeln und so ein möglichst inklusives und selbstbestimmtes Leben zu ermöglichen.WE CARE - was wir für Sie tunWir bieten Ihnen eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem engagierten und hilfsbereiten Team, eine attraktive und faire Bezahlung sowie zahlreicheBenefits:- Wöchentliche Teamgespräche, regelmäßige Supervisionen und enge Begleitung durch den einrichtungseigenen interdisziplinären Fachdienst- regelmäßige teambildende Maßnahmen- bis zu 36 Tage Urlaub- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Spezialisierte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. ProDeMa)- Job-Rad und Job-Ticket- Preisnachlässe beim Einkaufen- betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement z.B. eGYM Wellpass Zugang zu exklusiven Fitness- und WellnessangebotenWas ist Ihnen wichtig? Lassen Sie es uns wissen und wir schauen gemeinsam nach Lösungen.Was Sie Gutes tun- Sie arbeiten auf einer Wohngruppe mit erwachsenen Menschen mit geistigen und körperlichen Behinderungen- Sie übernehmen organisatorische und administrative, sowie hauswirtschaftliche Aufgaben- Sie entwickeln Strukturierungs- und Visualisierungshilfen und setzen diese in der Praxis ein. Sie arbeiten u.a. nach dem TEACCH-Konzept- Sie arbeiten eng mit dem individuellen Umfeld des/der Klient*in zusammenWas Sie dafür mitbringen- Sie bringen eine Ausbildung als Fachkraft mit als Heilerziehungspflegerin, Sozialpädagogin, Pflegefachkraft oder vergleichbare Qualifikation- Sie haben Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und sind aufgeschlossen gegenüber dem besonderen Personenkreis und sind bereit, im Schichtdienst zu arbeiten- Sie verfügen über eine gute Reflektionsfähigkeit und können empathisch auf die individuellen Bedarfe der Menschen eingehen- Die Zugehörigkeit zu einer christlichen Kirche ist kein Muss, alle sind willkommen. Aber es ist uns wichtig, dass alle Mitarbeitenden unsere christlichen Werte wie Nächstenliebe, Respekt und Verantwortung mittragen und im Berufsalltag lebenMehr zur Diakonie Stetten e.V. erfahren Sie hierAlles Wichtige im ÜberblickEinstiegszeitpunktab sofortArbeitsortHangweide 15-17, 71394 KernenArbeitsumfang50 - 100% (19,50 - 39,0 Std./Wo.)TarifvertragAVR Wü – S8bSind Sie neugierig geworden? title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Assistant Archivist
description: Role ProfileThe successful candidate will report to the Librarian & Archivist, to process and catalogue incoming collections of archives and promote the content of the Library’s extensive holdings. The candidate will be part of the Library team and contribute to its ongoing work and outreach.BackgroundThe Library of the Representative Church Body provides a repository for the Church of Ireland’s archives, manuscripts and related objects which tell the story of the Church’s community. Book2Net Lizard, Tocosa, Silverfast9). Knowledge / Skills    Essential•    Excellent communication skills including making presentations and engaging with relevant stakeholders•    Experience curating small displays for exhibition•    Proficient in Microsoft Access (including database management and reporting)•    Experience in developing and managing websites and organisational social media accounts, including updating content and maintaining an online presence.•    Excellent organisational and inter-personal skills with proven ability to work to deadlines and prioritise workloadsDesirable•    Experience researching and writing content for publications including online and print content

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Localisation QA Engineer with French - Canadian Market
description: OverviewGlobeTech is a global provider of software localisation, translation, quality assurance (QA) and data analysis services to the multinational IT sector. We provide market-leading solutions to our clients, with the core objective of helping them expand and grow their businesses in an increasingly personalised and data-driven world.Established in 1997 by two expert engineers, our bespoke services have enabled us to expand globally and become a trusted partner to our clients. Why? Because we work with excellent people!Are you ready to start a new career opportunity and relocate to Cork, Ireland? We are looking for talented individuals to join our growing team as a Localisation QA Engineer within the consumer electronics sector.In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the world's most innovative software products, in a dynamic company culture and alongside cutting-edge technologies.As a Localisation QA Engineer, you and your team will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a wide variety of software products in your native language. title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

We provide market-leading solutions to our clients, with the core objective of helping them expand and grow their businesses in an increasingly personalised and data-driven world.Established in 1997 by two expert engineers, our bespoke services have enabled us to expand globally and become a trusted partner to our clients. title: Healthcare Assistant (Kerry)
description: You will be a healthcare assistant working across our Social Care division.Hours:  Full time permanent 39 hoursWhat is the Role?              You will provide a professional, high quality and safe service as a healthcare assistant to people with additional needs - working as part of a team and in consultation with each service user. title: Business Strategist
description: Townbe Unlimited Company, 22 Northumberland Road, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4, D04 ED73, wishes to recruit a Business Strategist, to work at 21 Aungier Street, Dublin 2, D02 H322, for the formulation of a comprehensive and holistic strategic plan, which shall be regularly reviewed and, where necessary adapted, to chart the development and growth of the business over a 3-5 years time span, taking particular account of the general economic environment and the projected demand for the company’s accommodation offerings. title: Financial Reporting Assistant

title: tecnico chimico
description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli in matrice acquosa ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti sistemi di incentivazione e premi di risultato; Piano Welfare; Mensa aziendale. description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. title: Tecnico_a di messa in servizio
description:
Hai sempre desiderato lavorare in un settore dinamico e orientato al futuro, contribuendo così alla produzione di energia sostenibile e rinnovabile? Questa è la tua occasione per contribuire a plasmare un futuro verde insieme a Thöni Sustainable Solutions! Da oltre 30 anni realizziamo impianti di biogas in tutto il mondo e siamo leader tecnologici in questo settore. 1 Tecnico_a di messa in servizio Location:

Italia

Type of Employment:

Full time

Your tasks

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Controlli funzionali e di sicurezza di tutti i sistemi in conformità alle norme tecniche

* Regolazione e ottimizzazione dei parametri dell'impianto per un funzionamento conforme al contratto

* Assistenza durante il collaudo tecnico

* Formazione e istruzione del personale operativo in loco

* Documentazione dei lavori eseguiti e verbali di consegna

* Stretta collaborazione con i responsabili di progetto, i tecnici e il team di assistenza

Your profile

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. In quanto azienda familiare di successo, attribuiamo grande importanza a un clima di rispetto reciproco e a una collaborazione orientata al lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, ci impegniamo attivamente a favore della sostenibilità e della tutela dell'ambiente, implementando processi che preservano le risorse e lavorando costantemente alla riduzione della nostra impronta ecologica.

T: +43 5262 6903-0

Obermarktstraße 48, A-6410 Telfs

Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. title: consulente legale
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. For a client company operating in the technology and travel sector, we are looking for a: POLICY AND REGULATORY MANAGER - SOUTHERN EUROPE What will you be responsible for? Developing and implementing regulatory strategies and compliance solutions across Southern Europe, with a primary focus on Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Managing relationships with local and national governments, regulatory authorities, tax authorities and other institutional stakeholders. Monitoring and analysing tax and fiscal regulations, particularly those concerning short-term rentals, tourist tax collection, registration and data sharing. Managing agreements with Italian municipalities on tourist tax and supporting regulatory negotiations and legislative initiatives. Collaborating with legal, product and international teams to develop compliance tools, regulatory policies and solutions. Preparing policy papers, regulatory analyses and position statements, while identifying partnership opportunities with public institutions and external stakeholders. Do you have the following skills and qualifications? At least 7 years of relevant experience in tax, fiscal, regulatory and compliance matters. A degree in Law or a tax-related field is mandatory. Strong knowledge of the Italian regulatory framework and legislative processes; knowledge of other Southern European markets is an advantage. Proven experience in stakeholder management, institutional relations and complex project management. Excellent analytical, organisational, communication and negotiation skills. Fluency in Italian and English. Flexibility to travel frequently within Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours weekly. Contract offer: Employment through a fixed-term temporary agency contract. Applicable collective agreement (CCNL): Commerce. Classification level: Level 1. Salary: €84,000-€86,000 gross per year (RAL). Work location: Milan or Rome, with regular travel to Milan required for candidates based in Rome, including overnight stays, and frequent business travel across Southern Europe. If you have the skills and experience required for this role, we look forward to receiving your application! title: consulente in energia solare
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite-enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale #LI-CP Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-90K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio
