title: Universitetslektor i matematikkdidaktikk ved Matematikksenteret
description:
Dette er NTNU

NTNU er et breddeuniversitet med en teknisk-naturvitenskapelig hovedprofil og et tyngdepunkt innen profesjonsutdanning. Universitetet er lokalisert i tre byer med hovedsete i Trondheim.

På NTNU jobber 9 000 ansatte og 43 000 studenter med å skape kunnskap for en bedre verden.

Du finner mer informasjon om NTNU som arbeidsplass og søkeprosessen her.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sOm stillingen

Matematikksenteret - Nasjonalt senter for matematikk i opplæringen - skal bidra til økt kvalitet i matematikkopplæringen i Norge. Vi er tett knyttet til skolen og praksisfeltet, og arbeidet vårt er forsknings- og praksisbasert. Matematikksenterets målgruppe er lærerutdanningene, skole- og barnehageeiere, ledere og ansatte i skolen, barnehagen og PP-tjenesten. Våre 30 ansatte har bred kompetanse innenfor matematikkdidaktikk og jobber med kompetanseutvikling, forskning, formidling og utvikling av læringsressurser og digitale verktøy. Senteret drifter i dag fem nettsteder, vi leder flere nasjonale nettverk og arrangerer nasjonale konferanser. Matematikksenteret har fått hovedansvar for den nasjonale satsningen i matematikk som er omtalt i Meld. St. 34 – En mer praktisk skole. Dette innebærer flere spennende oppdrag knyttet til kompetanseutvikling og utvikling av forskningsbaserte læringsressurser. Nærmere opplysninger finnes på www.matematikksenteret.no. 

Stillingenes varighet er på 2 år. 

Din nærmeste leder er senterleder. 

Ønsker du å bidra i et utviklingsorientert miljø og være med på å forme fremtidens matematikkundervisning? Da håper vi å høre fra deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • delta aktivt i Matematikksenterets arbeid knyttet til den nasjonale satsingen i matematikk 
  • planlegge og gjennomføre senterets prosjekter og arbeidsoppgaver 
  • arbeide med kompetanseutvikling, nettverk og konferanser, utvikling av læringsressurser og spredning rettet mot lærerutdanningene, skole- og barnehageeiere, ledere og ansatte i skolen, barnehagen og PP-tjenesten 
  • ivareta oppgaver innen senterets kommunikasjonsarbeid 
  • ha faglig ansvar i samarbeid med andre vitenskapelige ansatte ved senteret 
  • gjennomføre forsknings- og utviklingsarbeid med relevans for senterets virksomhet

Stillingen kombineres med undervisningsstilling i skolen. 

Arbeidet omfatter deltakelse på fysiske møter og samlinger ved Matematikksenteret, med mulighet for hjemmekontor. Vi oppfordrer kandidater fra hele landet til å søke på stillingen.

Kvalifikasjonskrav

Du må kvalifisere for stilling som universitetslektor innenfor fagområdet matematikk/matematikkdidaktikk i henhold til følgende krav: 

  • mastergrad eller tilsvarende i matematikk/matematikkdidaktikk 
  • godkjent praktisk-pedagogisk utdanning eller tilsvarende 
  • bred undervisningserfaring i matematikk fra norsk grunnskole eller videregående skole 
  • bred erfaring med skolebasert kompetanseutviklingsarbeid i matematikk fra norsk skole 
  • du arbeider som matematikklærer i norsk grunnskole eller videregående skole 
  • meget god muntlig og skriftlig formuleringsevne i norsk 

Du må dokumentere relevant grunnleggende kompetanse for undervisning og veiledning på universitet- og høgskolenivå jfr NTNUs retningslinjer for vitenskapelige stillinger. Dersom du ikke kan dokumentere dette, pålegges du å gjennomføre et godkjent kurs i universitetspedagogikk i løpet av to år etter ansettelse. NTNU tilbyr kvalifiserende kurs.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • bred erfaring med utviklingsarbeid i matematikk med relevans for norsk skole 
  • erfaring med formidling av matematikk/matematikkdidaktikk med relevans for norsk skole 
  • nettverk i målgruppen til senteret, som er lærerutdanningene, skole- og barnehageeiere, ledere og ansatte i skolen, barnehagen og PP-tjenesten
 Personlige egenskaper
  • gode samarbeidsevner 
  • selvstendighet 
  • vilje til å ta eget initiativ 
  • god arbeidskapasitet 
  • god fleksibilitet 
  • utviklingsorientert 

Personlige og mellommenneskelige egenskaper vil bli lagt vekt på.

Vi tilbyr
  • spennende og utviklende oppgaver i et sterkt og internasjonalt fagmiljø 
  • et sosialt, åpent og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger 
  • støtte fra fagfolk med kompetanse på administrasjon og kommunikasjon 
  • konkurransedyktige betingelser og gunstige vilkår i Statens pensjonskasse 
  • ansattgoder
NTNU – inkludering og mangfold 

Mangfold er en styrke, og ved NTNU har vi et mål om å være en arbeidsgiver som gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet og som tar i bruk potensialet i befolkningens samlede kompetanser. Vår visjon er Kunnskap for en bedre verden og våre verdier er kreativ, kritisk, konstruktiv og respektfull. Vi har tro på at en virksomhet som er likestilt, mangfoldig og kjønnsbalansert er avgjørende for at vi sammen når våre mål.   

Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning av vårt samfunnsoppdrag innen forskning og utdanning.

Lønn og vilkår

I stillingen som universitetslektor (kode 1009) vil du normalt lønnes fra brutto fra kr 645 000 – 795 000,- pr. år avhengig av kvalifikasjoner og ansiennitet. Fra lønnen trekkes lovfestet 2 % innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse. 

Ansettelsen blir gjennomført etter prinsippene i statsansatteloven, og lovverk som regulerer eksport av kunnskap, teknologi og tjenester. Etter ansettelsen må du påregne at det kan skje endringer i arbeidsområdet. 

For nødvendig samhandling faglig og sosialt er det en forutsetning at du er tilgjengelig for institusjonen i avtalt arbeidstid. 

Matematikksenteret er et nasjonalt senter som har oppdrag over hele Norge. Utførelse av arbeidsoppgavene i denne stillingen vil derfor medføre noe reiseaktivitet.

Om søknaden

Søknaden og beskrivelsen av de vitenskapelige arbeidene som skal legges til grunn for bedømmelsen skal foreligge på norsk/skandinavisk. 

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søknaden kun blir vurdert ut fra informasjonen som foreligger ved søknadsfristen. Sørg derfor for at søknaden din tydelig viser hvordan dine ferdigheter og erfaringer oppfyller kriteriene som er beskrevet over. Søknad og alle vedlegg sendes elektronisk via Jobbnorge. Ved forespørsel må du kunne fremskaffe bekreftede kopier av din dokumentasjon. 

Hvis du har hatt permisjon eller annet avbrekk i din karriere, er det viktig at dette kommer fram i søknaden din slik at rekrutteringsgruppen kan ta hensyn til dette og at mengden av forskningen din kan være redusert som et resultat.

Søknaden må inneholde:

  • CV, attester og vitnemål
  • pedagogisk mappe, der din utdanningsfaglige kompetanse fremstilles systematisk og samlet, jf Dokumentasjon av pedagogiske kvalifikasjoner ved søknad og ansettelse i vitenskapelig stilling
  • faglige bidrag - trykte eller utrykte - som du ønsker det skal tas hensyn til ved bedømmelsen (inntil 8 arbeider) 
  • opplysninger om prosjekter du har deltatt i eller vært prosjektleder for med informasjon om varighet og størrelse 
  • navn og adresse til tre relevante referanser

Det er viktig at du både dokumenterer og reflekterer over din kompetanse. Vi oppfordrer deg til å bruke NTNUs kompetansematrise som verktøy for dokumentasjon av din kompetanse.

Det vil bli tatt hensyn til fellesarbeider. Dersom det i fellesarbeid er vanskelig å identifisere innsatsen din, må du legge ved en kort redegjørelse for din medvirkning. 

Ved vurdering av den best kvalifiserte legger vi vekt på personlig egnethet, din motivasjon for stillingen og dine pedagogiske evner og kvalifikasjoner. Kunstig intelligens (KI) kan brukes som støtte til enkelte administrative oppgaver, for eksempel til å utarbeide caseoppgaver eller forslag til intervjuspørsmål. Alle vurderinger og beslutninger i rekrutteringsprosessen gjøres av mennesker. 

Vår vurdering vil bygge på dokumentert pedagogisk materiale, fremstillingsformer i de vitenskapelige arbeider, erfaring fra undervisning og veiledning, samt pedagogisk bakgrunn av annen art. Kvalitet og bredde vil bli vurdert, og åpen vitenskapspraksis anerkjennes.

NTNU forplikter seg til å følge evalueringskriterier for forskningskvalitet i henhold til The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA  og forpliktelsene i CoARA om ansvarlig vurdering av forskning og anerkjennelse av en større bredde av faglige bidrag.  Dette innebærer at vi legger spesielt vekt på kvaliteten og den faglige bredden dine vitenskapelige arbeider dokumenterer. Vi tar også hensyn til forskningsledelse og deltakelse i forskningsprosjekter. Vi legger størst vekt på dine vitenskapelige arbeider fra de siste fem år.

Søknaden din vil bli vurdert av en komite. Aktuelle kandidater vil bli invitert til prøveundervisning og intervju.

Generell informasjon

Som ansatt ved NTNU må du til enhver tid rette deg etter endringer som utviklingen i faget medfører, og de organisatoriske endringer som vedtas. 

Offentlig søkerliste med navn, alder, stillingstittel og bostedskommune utarbeides etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste må dette begrunnes. Vurdering vil bli gjort i henhold til gjeldende lovverk. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge. 

Hvis du har spørsmål om stillingen kan du ta kontakt med senterleder Kjersti Wæge, e-post: kjersti.wage@matematikksenteret.no  

Hvis du har spørsmål om ansettelsesprosessen kan du ta kontakt med HR-rådgiver Terese Brå, e-post: terese.bra@ntnu.no  

Synes du dette ser interessant ut, og i samsvar med dine kvalifikasjoner, sender du oss din søknad elektronisk via jobbnorge.no med CV, vitnemål og attester vedlagt. Ved forespørsel må du kunne fremskaffe bekreftede kopier av din dokumentasjon.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Søknadsfrist: 07.12.2026 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - kunnskap for en bedre verden Ved NTNU, Norges teknisk-naturvitenskapelige universitet, skapes kunnskap for en bedre verden og løsninger som kan forandre hverdagen. Institutt for lærerutdanning Vi har et fullverdig utdanningstilbud for grunnskole og videregående opplæring.Et faglig sterkt og inkluderende kollegium retter forskning og kunstnerisk virksomhet mot læring, utdanning og skoleutvikling. Institutt for lærerutdanning er ett av instituttene ved Fakultet for samfunns- og utdanningsvitenskap.

title: Seksjonsleiar
description:
Medisinsk sengepost 1 ved Førde sentralsjukehus har ledig fast stilling som seksjonsleiar.

Vi søkjer deg som vil vere med å leie ein sengepost i kontinuerleg utvikling, der fagleg engasjement, kvalitetsforbetring og pasientbehandling står sentralt.

Om avdelingaMedisinsk sengepost 1 har nyresjukdommar, diabetes, endokrinologi, hjartesjukdommar og geriatri som spesialiserte fagfelt, og samarbeider tett med medisinsk sengepost 2 som i hovudsak har pasientar innan mage- og tarmsjukdommar, lungesjukdommar, lungekreft og utgreiing. Sengepost 1 driftar i tillegg geriatrisk poliklinikk tilknytta sengeposten.

Vi søkjer deg som vil vere med å leie ein sengepost i kontinuerleg utvikling, der fagleg engasjement, kvalitetsforbetring og pasientbehandling står sentralt.

Om stillingaSeksjonsleiar har einskapleg ansvar for fag, økonomi og personal og har avdelingssjef som næraste overordna. Det er tett samarbeid med lege- og sekretærtenesta på posten samt med seksjonsleiar og tilsette ved Medisinsk sengepost 1.For stillinga krevst det dokumentert autorisasjon som sjukepleiar. Det er ein fordel med god kjennskap til faglege og driftsmessige utfordringar i ein indremedisinsk sengepost, samt vidareutdanning innan helseleiing.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Einskapleg leiing med ansvar for fag, personal og økonomiansvar i samsvar med Helse Førde sine prinsipp for leiing
  • Oppgåveplanlegging og ressurfordeling
  • Oppfølging av medarbeidarar
  • Kompetanseutvikling og kvalitetssikring
  • Månadleg rapportering av aktivitet og økonomi
  • Budsjettarbeid
  • Deltaking i leiarmøter i avdeling, klinikk og føretak
  • Kvalitetsarbeid, inkludert internkontroll, avvikshandtering, forbetringarbeid 
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Vidareutdanning innan leiing, og/eller erfaring som fagleiar eller administrativ leiar i helsetenesta 
  • Sjukepleiefagleg kompetanse og god klinisk praksis
  • Gode IKT-kunnskapar og tryggleik i bruk av digitale verktøy
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Du har organisatoriske evner og trivst med å samarbeide tett med andre
  • Du er fleksibel og positiv, men også resultatorientert og beslutningsdyktig
  • Du fremjar god kommunikasjon og samhandling internt og eksternt i organisasjonen
  • Du taklar høg aktivitet og høgt arbeidstempo
Vi tilbyr
  • Avdelinga tilbyr godt arbeidsmiljø og støttande samarbeid mellom seksjonane og avdelingssjef i medisinsk avdeling
  • Ein spennande og variert arbeidskvardag med faglege og leiarmessige utfordringar
  • Moglegheit for fagleg utvikling innan både leiing og fagområde
  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar 

 

Vi oppfordrar alle søkjarar til å nytte Vitnemålsportalen for å laste opp verifiserte vitnemål og karakterutskrifter, der det er mogleg. Har du utdanning frå utlandet, legg ved godkjenning frå Direktoratet for høgare utdanning og kompetanse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Helse Førde HF har ansvar for spesialisthelsetenestene i Sogn og Fjordane. Føretaket arbeider for å gje pasientar og brukarar eit godt og heilskapeleg tilbod innanfor gjeldande rammer. Helse Førde sine institusjonar og prehospitale tenester er organisert i eit heilskapleg nettverk, og samarbeidet med andre instansar som m.a. kommunane er høgt prioritert. Føretaket har om lag 3 200 tilsette og eit budsjett på ca 4 milliardar kroner og er den største verksemda i Sogn og Fjordane. Forsking og innovasjon er og viktige oppgåver i sjukehuset.

Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkje ledige stillingar uansett kjønn, alder,  fleirkulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphald frå arbeidslivet. Føretaksgruppa i Helse Vest ønskjer å leggje til rette for inkluderande rekruttering.

title: Hjelpearbeider vei tilkalling Rogaland og Agder
description:
Vil du ha en praktisk og variert arbeidshverdag ute på vei? Vi søker en ansvarsbevisst hjelpearbeider (tilkallingshjelp) som kan jobbe i Rogaland og/eller Agder.

Hos Risa blir du en del av et arbeidsmiljø der sikkerhet, samarbeid og kvalitet står sentralt. Vi ser etter deg som arbeider strukturert, følger etablerte rutiner og bidrar positivt sammen med kollegaene dine.

Det kan bli mulig med fast jobb på sikt.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utføre manuell trafikkdirigering og arbeidsvarsling i henhold til gjeldende krav.
  • Sørge for sikker og effektiv trafikkavvikling på arbeidsstedet.
  • Bistå med praktiske oppgaver knyttet til drift og vedlikehold.
  • Bruke digitale verktøy for registrering og rapportering.
  • Kontrollere og ivareta tildelt utstyr og kjøretøy.
  • Rapportere avvik og bidra til et sikkert og godt arbeidsmiljø.

  • Kurs i arbeidsvarsling 1 og 3
  • Førerkort B er et krav (manuell gir)
  • Førerkort BE og C er ønskelig
  • Forståelse for sikkerhet og risikoforhold ved arbeid på og langs vei
  • Evne til å bruke digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • Forståelse for viktigheten av å følge prosedyrer, skilting og kontrolltiltak
Personlige egenskaper
  • Har fokus på sikkerhet og ansvarlighet
  • Er serviceinnstilt og har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Trives med utendørs arbeid i all slags vær
  • Er fleksibel 
  • Kan beholde roen og ta gode beslutninger i utfordrende situasjoner
Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag
  • God opplæring og nødvendig kurs
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer

Høres dette ut som en stilling for deg? Da ønsker vi gjerne å høre fra deg

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Om Risa

Risa AS er en del av R-konsernet. R er et familieeid investeringsselskap med hovedsete på Jæren, eid av 3 og 4 generasjon Risa.  Konsernet er bygget stein for stein siden 1948 til dagens konsern med over 1000 ansatte, 2,8 milliarder kroner i omsetning og 1,2 milliarder kroner i verdijustert egenkapital. Mennesker, kvalitet og HMS står i sentrum, og en aktiv og sunn livsstil er en viktig del av kulturen vår. Det er menneskene som utgjør forskjellen – derfor investerer vi langsiktig i våre ansatte, bygger kompetanse og legger til rette for utvikling, fordi vi vet at forskjellen er deg.

title: Miljøterapeut
description:
Er du sjukepleiar eller vernepleiar og ønskjer ein meiningsfull jobb der du bidreg til tryggleik, meistring og livskvalitet for andre?

  • Me søkjer ein engasjert og trygg miljøterapeut til 80 % fast stilling i nyoppretta avdeling i rus og psykisk helse - Mikkjelsflaten i Øystese.
  • Avdelinga har ei arbeidstidsordning som inkluderer langvakter. Det er ønskjeleg at søkjar er positiv til langvakter, men deltaking i langvaktordninga er frivillig
  • Me tilbyr heildøgns omsorg til ni personar med psykiske lidingar som ikkje kan bu i eigen heim.
  • Målet er å skapa eit trygt, stabilt og inkluderande bumiljø. 

Som miljøterapeut vil du bidra til å skapa struktur og tryggleik i kvardagen til bebuarane. Du vil følgja opp og støtta i daglege gjeremål, leggja til rette for sosial deltaking og vera ein viktig medspelar i arbeidet med å fremja meistring og sjølvstende.   Dette er ei spennande moglegheit for deg som ønskjer å vera med på etableringa og vidareutviklinga av eit nytt tilbod innan psykisk helsearbeid.

Arbeidsoppgåver

Arbeidsoppgåver

  • Oppfølging og støtte til bebuarar i daglege gjeremål og bidra til eit trygt og inkluderande bumiljø
  • Pleie knytt til personleg hygiene og stell
  • Skapa struktur i kvardagen
  • Planleggja og gjennomføra aktivitetar
  • Leggja til rette for meistring, sjølvstende og sosial deltaking
  • Observasjon og dokumentasjon
  • Samarbeid med pårørande og anna hjelpeapparat
  • Medikamenthandtering
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Norsk autorisasjon som sjukepleiar eller vernepleiar
  • Har du arbeidserfaring/utdanning innan psykisk helsearbeid er det ei føremon
  • Du må ha interesse for fagfeltet psykisk helse
  • Gode norskkunnskapar, både munnleg og skriftleg
  • Digital kompetanse og erfaring med dokumentasjonssystem

Ved nytilsetjing skal den tilsette levera politiattest utan merknader, etter Helse og omsorgslova. Denne skal ikkje leggast ved søknaden, men må leverast til leiar før oppstart i stillinga. Politiattesten må ikkje vera eldre enn 3 månadar. 

Ber om at du lastar opp vitnemål og attestar saman med søknaden i Webcruiter.

Personlege eigenskapar
  • Trygg og tydeleg i rolla
  • Gode samarbeidsevner
  • Arbeider strukturert og ansvarsfullt
  • Empatisk og evne til å byggja gode relasjonar

title: Are you passionate about crisis management, emergency preparedness and building organizational resilience in a global organization?
description:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Global Security Manager – Crisis Management to strengthen our global security and resilience capability.

In this role, your main responsibility will be crisis management and business continuity, you will work close with our team, and also be involved in a variety of security areas such as personnel security, physical security, information security and travel security. 

You will have a key responsibility for further developing our global approach to crisis management and emergency preparedness. You will work closely with management, security professionals, business units and functions across the organization to ensure that we are prepared to respond effectively when serious incidents occur.The position combines strategic development, governance and hands-on operational crisis management, and requires someone who is comfortable working both proactively and in situations where time, information and predictability may be limited.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve the company’s global Crisis Management framework, including governance, processes, plans and supporting tools.
  • Support and further develop the organization’s Emergency Response and Crisis Management structure globally.
  • Support the establishment and development of local and regional emergency response capabilities, crisis management exercises and training for management teams and relevant functions.
  • Contribute to the broader development of Business Continuity Management and organizational resilience.
  • Together with the Security team you will monitor relevant global developments and emerging risks that may affect our people and operations.
  • Participate in operational crisis response when required, as a important coordinating role in the global crisis management team.
  • Collaborate with the Travel Security Board team. 
We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for! 

What we are looking for:

We believe you have solid experience within crisis management, emergency preparedness, security, resilience or related disciplines, combined with the ability to translate frameworks and requirements into practical solutions.Relevant experience may come from international industry, corporate security, emergency preparedness, defence, police, public authorities or consulting.We are particularly interested in candidates who have:

  • Experience with crisis management and emergency response in a complex organization.
  • Experience developing crisis management plans, frameworks and response structures.
  • Experience planning and facilitating exercises, training and scenario-based crisis management activities.
  • Experience supporting management during serious incidents or crises.
  • Strong understanding of crisis leadership, decision-making and coordination under pressure.
  • Ability to work across organizational, geographical and cultural boundaries.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international organization with global operations will be considered an advantage.Knowledge of recognized standards and good practices within crisis management and business continuity, including ISO 22301 and ISO 27001, will also be beneficial. 

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.This employment requires security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority. The successful candidate may start work with limited accesses whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment. Personal qualitiesTo succeed in this role, you are structured and analytical, while also being pragmatic and operational when the situation requires it.You:
  • remain calm and focused in demanding situations;
  • are comfortable making progress when information is incomplete;
  • communicate clearly with both management and operational teams;
  • build trust and strong professional relationships;
  • take initiative and drive improvement;
  • are curious and continuously look for ways to strengthen preparedness;
  • understand that effective crisis management is ultimately about people, leadership, preparation and the ability to act.

You should also be comfortable working in an international environment and travelling when required.

Why join us?

Serious incidents rarely follow the plan. - Good crisis management therefore depends not only on having procedures in place, but on having an organization that is prepared, trained and capable of making good decisions when it matters most.As Global Security Manager – Crisis Management, you will have the opportunity to influence how a global organization prepares for and responds to critical events, working across countries, functions and management levels.You will be part of a professional security environment where preparedness, learning and continuous improvement are important elements in protecting our people, operations and business. 

 Work location:Any of Kongsberg Maritimes locations in Norway, though Kongsberg, Horten or Lysaker is preferred.We are flexible on working arrangements. Point of contact:Hanne Marit SchultzDirector Security & Crisis ManagementTel: +47 913 42 479 Link til søknadsskjema: Send application

title: PhD Candidate - Hydrogen and Industrial Decarbonization Pathways
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

We invite applications for a 3-year PhD Candidate position on the future role of hydrogen and hydrogen products in industrial decarbonization. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT) is to carry out education, research, and innovation activities at an international level at the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE. The department’s activities aim to contribute to sustainable value creation within technology-based areas in industry, business, and the public sector in Norway

 

About the position

Electrification is widely promoted as a key pathway to industrial decarbonization. At the same time, hydrogen and carbon capture and storage (CCS) are increasingly recognized as important solutions for sectors where direct electrification may be difficult or uneconomic. This has led to a growing debate about the future role of "electrons versus molecules" in a net-zero economy.

Most existing studies assume that today's industrial structure remains largely unchanged and focus on how current industries can reduce emissions. However, deep decarbonization may fundamentally reshape industrial production, value chains, competitiveness, and the location of energy-intensive activities. As a result, future hydrogen demand may depend as much on industrial transformation as on technological choices.

This PhD project will investigate how alternative pathways toward a zero-emission industrial sector affect the future demand for hydrogen and the development of hydrogen value chains. The research will analyze the interplay between electrification, hydrogen, and CCS, while explicitly accounting for potential changes in industrial structures and production systems.

 

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How will future hydrogen demand vary across alternative industrial decarbonization pathways?
  • Which industrial sectors are likely to rely on electrification, hydrogen, or CCS to achieve net-zero emissions?
  • How might industrial transformation affect hydrogen production, transport, storage, and trade?
  • What level of hydrogen deployment is required to justify dedicated hydrogen infrastructure and markets?
  • How can Europe and Norway prepare for different industrial and energy-system transition pathways?

 

The successful candidate will develop and analyze future scenarios for industrial transformation, hydrogen demand, and infrastructure development. The project will contribute to the scientific and policy debate on how competitive zero-emission industries can emerge under different transition strategies.

Research environment

The PhD candidate will join a multidisciplinary research environment at the intersection of energy economics, industrial economics, operations research, and energy systems analysis.

The position is affiliated with FME HYDROGENi, the Norwegian Research and Innovation Centre for Hydrogen and Ammonia. The centre brings together 46 research and industry partners to develop the knowledge, technologies, and solutions needed to support a sustainable hydrogen economy and contribute to Norway's ambitions for climate neutrality and industrial transformation. FME HYDROGENi conducts research across the hydrogen value chain, including hydrogen production, transport and storage, industrial and maritime applications, safety, and the broader role of hydrogen in future energy systems. The centre is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Centres for Environment-friendly Energy Research (FME) programme and operates during the period 2022-2030

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project

The PhD candidate will:

  • Conduct original scientific research on hydrogen and industrial decarbonization pathways.
  • Develop and analyze scenarios for industrial transformation and climate neutrality.
  • Assess the future role of electrification, hydrogen, and CCS across industrial sectors.
  • Quantify hydrogen demand and infrastructure requirements under alternative transition pathways.
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences.
  • Collaborate with academic, industry, and public-sector partners.
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme.
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research findings.

 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU’s grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:

  • Operations research or optimization
  • Energy systems
  • Energy Economics
  • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Or other closely related disciplines.

Applicants must demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative skills.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with energy system modelling, scenario analysis, or techno-economic analysis.
  • Knowledge of hydrogen technologies, industrial decarbonization, or climate policy.
  • Experience with quantitative modelling and data analysis.
  • Programming skills in Python, Julia, R, GAMS, or similar tools.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of technology, economics, and policy.

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in an interdisciplinary research environment. 
  • Is interested in research with relevance for industry, policy, and society.

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Close collaboration with leading researchers in energy systems modelling, optimization, and something else 
  • Opportunities to engage with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in research addressing key challenges of the green transition.
  • Opportunities for international research stays and conference participation.
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU 

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

 

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of at least two potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI).  

If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.  

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates.  

NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public applicant list with names, ages, job titles, and municipalities of residence will be prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to reserve yourself from being included on the public applicant list, this must be justified. The assessment will be made in accordance with applicable laws. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is Norway's technology capital with a population of over 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens, and general equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized childcare is readily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers excellent educational opportunities (including international schools) and opportunities to enjoy nature, culture, and family life, with low crime rates and clean air quality.

Questions about the position can be directed to Professor Asgeir Tomasgard (asgeir.tomasgard @ntnu.no) or Professor Anne Neumann (anne.neumann@ntnu.no).

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Oddny Lyngvær at oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no.

 

An application including attachments should be sent electronically through www.jobbnorge.no

Application deadline: 11.12.2026

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management

We conduct research and teaching at an international level in the interface between technology/natural sciences and economics, management, and HSE (health, safety and the environment). Our goal is sustainable creation of value within technology-based areas in industry, business and the public sector in Norway. We have academic groups in Trondheim and Gjøvik. title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.

More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage
Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.

We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 – NOK 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Attractive welfare benefits
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter of maximum one page (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • A three-page project description including background/theoretical relevance, research aims, and planned methodological and analytical approaches, in addition to a one-page progress plan. The relevance of the PhD to the project should also be documented. The reference list is not included in the page limit
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor’s letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Up to three peer-reviewed academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment.

Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.The Department of Special Needs Education is one of the three departments at The Faculty of Educational Sciences.

The department focuses on basic and applied research and education of bachelor-, master- and doctoral level candidates within the field of special needs education in Norway. The department employs over 50 scientific staff in addition to about 20 administrative employees. The department has approximately 800 students distributed between bachelor- and master's degree studies in special needs education as well as PhD-studies.

title: IT lead
description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As IT Lead, you will establish and run Nordscale Operations’ internal IT function in Narvik. As our first internal IT appointment, you will initially focus on hands-on operations and employee support, working closely with our external IT provider. You will also collaborate across functions within the organisation, beyond day-to-day user support.

 

The scope covers internal corporate IT and access to partner systems. As the organisation grows, your responsibility will expand towards IT strategy.

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)

  • Run day-to-day IT operations: configure PCs and software, support users, and manage onboarding, accounts, access, and single sign-on across internal and partner systems.
  • Establish IT policies and procedures for cybersecurity, data protection, and business continuity; implement Nscale’s configuration and security requirements with site leadership and external specialists.
  • Manage equipment and software procurement, licences, asset lifecycles, and relationships with IT vendors and service providers.
  • Deliver upgrades, migrations, and technical refreshes; monitor performance, uptime, and user experience; and develop compatible, scalable infrastructure and support services.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may be an experienced IT consultant, systems administrator, or operational IT professional ready to build a function. Experience in or supporting larger organisations with several partners is valuable; previous senior IT leadership experience is not required.

 

You enjoy practical work, connect technical decisions with longer-term business needs, and keep up to date with technology trends.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Self-driven and structured, taking ownership of decisions, priorities, and outcomes.

title: Er du vår nye renholder på Karljohansvern?
description:
Bli en del av Forsvarsbyggs renholdsteam! Vi søker en renholder til fast 50% stilling.

Forsvarsbygg har en stor og profesjonell renholdsorganisasjon med over 400 ansatte, med ansvar for renhold i forsvarssektoren. Dette innebærer alt fra kontorarealer til operative militæranlegg over hele landet. Totalt forvalter vi rundt én million kvadratmeter renholdsareal, noe som gjør oss til en stor aktør i bransjen.

Vi legger stor vekt på kvalitet, struktur og gode rutiner i det daglige arbeidet. Renhold er en viktig del av førstelinjevedlikeholdet i Forsvarsbygg, og som renholder hos oss bidrar du til et trygt, trivelig og funksjonelt miljø for alle som bruker våre bygg og anlegg.

Les mer om Forsvarsbygg på www.forsvarsbygg.no/jobb

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utføre regelmessig og periodisk renhold, samt rengjøringsrelaterte oppgaver innen eget fagområde
  • Ivaretakelse av oppgaver knyttet til renholdstjenesten
  • Plikter å gjennomføre pålagte kurs i henhold til gjeldende kompetanseplan
  • Samarbeid med andre renholdsleverandører dersom dette er nødvendig
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du har en ryddig og strukturert tilnærming til arbeidsoppgavene. Vi skal levere gode renholdstjenester, som stiller krav til at du er opptatt av å levere god kvalitet og samarbeider godt med andre. Hvis du også har gode kommunikasjonsegenskaper, fleksibel og er serviceorientert vil dette kunne være riktig stilling for deg.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du må beherske norsk muntlig og skriftlig godt
  • Du må ha førerkort klasse B
  • Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring som renholder
  • Dersom du skal bli tilsatt som renholdsoperatør kreves fagbrev som renholder, hvis du ikke har fagbrev blir du tilsatt som renholdsbetjent
  • Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres for nivå Hemmelig og NATO Secret før tiltredelse. Les mer om sikkerhetsklarering på www.nsm.no
    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?

    I Forsvarsbygg vil du få en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag hvor du vil bidra til å bygge forsvarsevne hver dag. Vi satser på medarbeiderne våre, vi tilbyr kursing, etter- og videreutdanning. Vi har en familievennlig og fleksibel personalpolitikk med gode arbeidstidsordninger. Du vil også få tilgang til bedriftsidrettslag med varierte aktiviteter. Som ansatt hos oss får du medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, som er en av landets beste pensjonsordninger med mulighet for boliglån og gode forsikringsordninger.

    Andre opplysninger

    • Vi ber ikke om søknadsbrev. For oss er det mer relevant med en beskrivende CV som viser hva du har av erfaring og kompetanse. I stedet ber vi deg svare på noen spørsmål i søknadsskjemaet, og vi setter pris på utfyllende svar.
    • Hvis du har fagbrev som renholdsoperatør blir du tilsatt som renholdsoperatør i stillingskode 1130. Lønn fra kr. 504 500 til kr. 549 100
    • Hvis du ikke har fagbrev blir du tilsatt som renholdsbetjent i stillingskode 1129. Lønn fra kr. 470 100 til kr. 498 100
    • Vi ber om at du laster opp vitnemål og karakterutskrifter i søknaden din
    • Offentlig søkerliste utarbeides etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste må dette begrunnes. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge
    KontaktinformasjonAdelheid Eriksen, Renholdsleder distrikt Oslofjord, 97548120 ArbeidsstedNedre vei 22 3183 Horten Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Forsvarsbygg eiendomsforvaltning Renhold Referansenr.: 5202648240 Stillingsprosent: 50% Fast Søknadsfrist: 18.11.2026

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Forsvarsbygg er en etat underlagt Forsvarsdepartementet. Vi bygger, forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder bygg og anlegg som er avgjørende for Norges sikkerhet. Forsvarsbygg er en beredskapsetat, og vi skal levere på vårt oppdrag for Forsvaret i fred, krise og krig. 

    Vi forvalter cirka 13 000 bygg og anlegg, og gjennomfører rundt 700 investeringsprosjekter til enhver tid. Det gjør oss til Norges største offentlige eiendomsaktør. Ansvaret vårt spenner fra historiske festninger åpne for allmennheten til landets mest komplekse og samfunnskritiske forsvarsanlegg.

    Hos oss vil du kunne bidra med din kompetanse til å styrke den norske forsvarsevnen, og gjøre oss mer robust, bærekraftig og framtidsrettet.

    Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning.

title: Make an impact with us at Kongsberg Maritime.
employer: KONGSBERG MARITIME AS AVD BEKKAJORDET HORTEN
description:
We're seeking talented individuals to help us shape the maritime future. If you're ready to be part of this exciting journey, your adventure begins here!

The Global HSE Manager – Operational Safety is responsible for developing, maintaining and improving KM’s global approach to operational safety, with emphasis on preventing serious injuries and fatalities, strengthening operational risk management and ensuring effective implementation of operational control requirements across divisions, business units and sites.

The position supports the Global Director HSE in strengthening KM’s operational safety performance, ensuring consistent expectations for high-risk activities, incidents, investigations, learning and corrective actions, and enabling the organisation to manage operational safety risks through clear requirements, practical guidance and effective follow-up.

What you will be doing• Risk Management: Own the HSE Risk Management process, maintain the Global HSE Risk Register, and facilitate risk reviews and assurance activities.• Operational Control: Own the operational control process and coordinate the development, implementation and continuous improvement of global HSE operational controls.• Learning and Improvement: Own the global lessons learned and HSE Subject Matter Expert frameworks and facilitate HSE forums and meetings to strengthen knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.• Safety Culture: Drive Human and Organisational Performance (HOP) initiatives to strengthen KM’s safety culture.• Systems and Tools: Act as system owner, where assigned, for HSE tools and applications, including governance, development, supplier management, budgets and improvement roadmaps.• HSE Assurance and Support: Conduct audits and inspections, lead or support incident investigations, provide subject matter expertise, and deliver HSE training, advice and professional support.

We think you should have• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent relevant experience.• Solid experience with HSE risk management, operational controls and high-risk work activities.• Experience with incident reporting, serious incident investigations, corrective actions and sharing of lessons learned• Good knowledge of ISO 45001 and practical application of HSE management system requirements. Knowledge of ISO 14001 is an advantage• Good business understanding and ability to translate operational safety requirements into practical and effective ways of working• Experience from an operational HSE role is an advantage

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

You are able to• understand the organization's informal rules and structures and utilize political processes effectively to get things done• act on own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results• make an impact, convince and persuade others and promote plans and ideas successfully• use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocate your time effectively• demonstrate specialist knowledge and expertise in own area• communicate in a clear, precise and structured way

Why join us• An exciting and important position working for the world-leading supplier of maritime solutions• Be part of a diverse team spread across several countries, embracing collaboration and cultural diversity.• We offer flexible working hours.• We offer hybrid working arrangement.

Kongsberg Maritime’s strength lies in unity. Diverse minds, developing technologies for sustainable oceans, drive innovation worldwide

Where you will be workingAny KM location in Norway, Sweden, Finland, UK or Poland. Other global locations may be considered for strong internal candidates, though Europe is preferred due to time zones.

Interested in knowing more? ContactMagnus Soon ArnhusGlobal Director HSE +47 408 85 376

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Our People and Corporate Affairs Division is a key enabler to the Kongsberg Maritime strategy, unifying the support functions to deliver the business strategy and goals. We are closely connected to the operations and cover a wide breadth of different functions, with common themes of global functional and business support, external relations development, safety, security, people enablement and communications, operational excellence, and license to operate. The division includes People, HSE, Quality, Compliance, Export Control, Facility, Supply Chain, Communication and Public Affairs.

title: Logistics Supervisor – Data Centre Projects
description:
The right material, in the right place, at the right time.

Fortica builds and finishes data centres across Norway and the Nordics. As Logistics Supervisor you make sure materials, equipment and plant reach the site at the right time, in the right place and in good condition, safely and without holding up the work. This includes heavy and sensitive data centre equipment such as generators, transformers, switchgear, UPS units, chillers and server racks.

What you will do

  • Run the delivery schedule and the booking system for delivery slots, in line with the 2–6 week look-ahead plan

  • Plan oversized deliveries (routes, permits and escorts) and track long-lead equipment (items that take months to deliver)

  • Manage laydown areas (storage zones on site), unloading zones, site roads and the site store

  • Receive deliveries: check quantity, condition and paperwork, and report any damage

  • Coordinate cranes, forklifts and telehandlers, and take part in lift planning and risk assessments

  • Coordinate daily with subcontractors, suppliers and hauliers

  • Make sure safety (HSE) rules are followed and logistics areas are kept clean and tidy

  • Send a weekly logistics report and check logistics costs before invoices are approved

  • Lead a small team of delivery coordinators, storekeepers, plant operators and banksmen (signallers who guide lifts and vehicles)

Who you are

  • Hands-on experience with heavy lifting and site logistics on large construction projects

  • Experience leading a logistics or warehouse team

  • Structured, and good at planning ahead

  • Comfortable with Excel or similar planning tools

  • Good English, spoken and written

  • Driving licence class B

  • Lifting or forklift certificates (for example truckførerbevis) are a plus

What makes you a good fit

You plan ahead and keep control when there is a lot of time pressure. You stand firm on safety and stop unsafe lifts or deliveries. You communicate clearly and solve conflicts between subcontractors before they grow.

What we offer

  • 3:1 rotation (3 weeks on, 1 week off) with flights, accommodation and meals covered

  • 4 % pension and health insurance

  • We help you get your HMS card (the Norwegian ID card for everyone working on a construction site) if you do not have one

  • Real responsibility on large, modern projects

  • A safe workplace with fair terms and a written employment contract

  • Part of CTS Group, one of Europe's leading data centre design and build groups

You report to: Site Manager / Project ManagerLocation: Fyresdal, Norway

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We believe that through the right systems, talent and tools, it is possible to build better products, more quickly, at a lower cost.

We build with purpose – combining innovation, sustainability and openness to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions, while empowering people to think boldly, act responsibly and grow together.

title: Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway

Outdoor activities are part of everyday life — whether it is hiking, skiing, fishing, or simply enjoying the Northern Lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Want to help millions of people think better?

reMarkable makes paper tablets for people who think better on paper. Founded in Oslo in 2013, we’ve created a category of our own: distraction-free devices that combine the feel of pen on paper with the power of digital tools. Our products are used by people all over the world to think, focus and do their best work. We design our hardware, software and services in-house, and we’re a focused, high-ownership team where every role has a direct impact on the product and our customers.

You will be part of the Global ecommerce team, which is responsible for delivering an exceptional shopping experience on remarkable.com, our primary sales channel.

As a Senior Web Developer, you’ll play a key role in building and optimizing our eCommerce platform frontend, from customer experience to internal user experience. Embedded in cross-functional product teams and reporting to the Unit lead, you’ll implement modern designs using a contemporary tech stack, contribute to architectural decisions, champion engineering best practices, and mentor other developers.

Your responsibilities may include

  • Working within cross-functional teams, crafting sophisticated design and modern web that directly engage our users and drive business outcomes

  • Leading the development and optimization of new and existing web applications using our cutting-edge stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Sanity, and the latest in modern tooling. You'll be at the forefront of implementing solutions that are performant, scalable and maintainable

  • Improving our architecture by engaging in critical discussions on software architecture, technology selection, and framework adoption, directly influencing the technical roadmap

  • Cultivating engineering culture, lead by example in code quality, and contribute significantly to our CI initiatives

  • Mentoring junior and mid-level developers, help build a collaborative team that thrives on continuous learning and improvement

  • Enhance the efficiency of business users and enable effective tradeoffs across business and technology

  • Drive and impact business results, by optimizing conversion funnels, building new features and improving site performance to directly impact sales and enhance the customer journey

We are looking for candidates with the following experience

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React in medium to large-sized codebases

  • Experience with Tailwind CSS

  • Experience collaborating and communicating within cross-functional teams, including UX and visual designers, test automation engineers, and product managers

It would also be beneficial if you have

  • Relevant experience in eCommerce, including familiarity with eCommerce engines

  • Experience as a full-stack developer

  • Experience with Sanity

  • University degree in computer science or a related field

(Don't meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!)

Why we enjoy working at reMarkable

  • Encouragement to learn and grow in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, learning, and modern technology

  • 5 extra paid “reMarkable days” in addition to regular vacation.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment and towels

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.

Practical information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English

  • Location: Oslo, Norway

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionise livestock management, we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Electronics Engineer.

The product is small, solar-assisted and combines GNSS, LTE, Bluetooth, and many other technologies, so every design decision is a system integration problem. Join the NPD team that takes it from concept to pilot production.

What you’ll do

  • Design schematics and PCB layouts, and review designs with the team

  • Bring up new boards, subcircuits and reusable modules

  • Test and validate hardware from first prototype to pilot production

  • Build lab setups and find root causes when things break

  • Work with the embedded team on low power consumption. On a solar-powered device, every microamp counts

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or similar

  • Boards you have taken from schematic to working hardware, and a story about what went wrong on the way

  • Strong fundamentals: analogue, power and digital design, signal integrity, EMC basics, power optimisation

  • Confidence with oscilloscope, spectrum analyser, DMM and PCBA debugging and testing

  • Experience with a professional PCB CAD tool. We’re moving from Altium to KiCad.

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • RF and antenna design

Until now.

Vi ser etter deg som liker å skape ting, eksperimentere med ny teknologi og ikke minst få løsninger ut i markedet.

  • Benytte AI-verktøy aktivt for å effektivisere utviklingsarbeidet.

  • Bidra til tekniske veivalg, arkitektur og videreutvikling av konseptene.

  • Teste, forbedre og videreutvikle løsningene basert på tilbakemeldinger fra brukere og kunder.

Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:
