title: Arbeidsleder - Stillas bransjen
description:
Vi ser etter en arbeidsleder som kan lede vårt team og sikre effektiv og sikker gjennomføring av prosjektene våre. Vi er en ledende aktør innen stillas bygging, og vi søker en dyktig arbeidende formann for å styrke vårt team i Møre og Romsdal. Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe på spennende prosjekter, samtidig som du leder et kompetent team.

Hva vi ser etter

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Ansvarsfull og selvstendig.

  • Gode organisatoriske ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å motivere og veilede teammedlemmer.

  • Løsningsorientert og trygg i utfordrende situasjoner.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Lede og organisere stillasbygging på byggeplasser.

  • Sikre at prosjektene gjennomføres i henhold til sikkerhetskrav og forskrifter.

  • Koordinere arbeidsteamet og sørge for effektiv ressursbruk.

  • Utføre risikovurdering og sørge for sikkerheten på byggeplassen.

  • Kommunisere med prosjektledelse og kunder.

  • Delta aktivt i det praktiske stillasarbeidet.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Må ha godkjent sertifisering i stillasarbeid enten med fagbrev eller som godkjent stillasmontører etter § 17-4.

  • Minimum 5 års erfaring som arbeidende formann eller i relevant rolle.

  • Gode lederegenskaper og erfaring med teamledelse.

  • God forståelse for sikkerhet og risikovurdering.

  • Førerkort for bil (fordel med BE og CE) og gjerne truckførerbevis.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn.

  • Gode arbeidsforhold i et støttende arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.

  • Fast ansettelse med forsikringsordninger og pensjonsavtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fjord Stillas As er et selskap som driver med utleie og montering av stillas, samt opplæring innenfor stillas faget. Fjord Stillas As henvender seg i all hovedsak mot proffmarkedet. Vi har hatt en stor del av vår virksomhet rettet mot privat og forskjellige industrier, hvor vi har stillas ansvar for prosjektledelse, montering og stillas utstyr. Vi har også mye aktivitet mot bygg og anleggsbransjen. Utleie parken består av fasade og spirstillas i aluminium, som vi monterer og leier ut over hele Møre og Romsdal. Fjord Stillas As har 8 egne montører og leier inn ekstra montører ved behov.

title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics or Physics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented, sound knowledge of one or more of the following topics: C*-algebras, noncommutative geometry, representation theory and its applications to quantum groups, quantum field theory, quantum information theory
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in a Scandinavian language

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest) of maximum length 2 A4 pages.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Letters of recommendation: these are not to be submitted with the application, but may be requested later during the evaluation process
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic. We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 10.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

title: Erfarne forskalingssnekkere, jernbindere og betongarbeidere søkes
description:
Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter erfarne og selvstendige forskalingssnekkere, jernbindere og betongarbeidere som ønsker å jobbe på spennende bygge- og anleggsprosjekter i Oslo og Akershus.

Du bør ha:

  • Erfaring som forskalingssnekker, jernbinder eller betongarbeider.

  • Evne til å lese tekniske tegninger.

  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og i team.

  • Fokus på kvalitet, HMS og godt samarbeid.

  • Førerkort klasse B er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

  • Du må kunne kommunisere på engelsk, polsk eller et skandinavisk språk.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere avhengig av prosjekt og kan blant annet omfatte:

  • Forskaling.

  • Armering.

  • Betongarbeid og støpearbeid.

  • Montering av prefab-elementer (på enkelte prosjekter).

  • Arbeid på bolig-, nærings- og infrastrukturprosjekter som tunneler, broer, kaianlegg og damanlegg.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast ansettelse i en seriøs norsk bedrift.

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter kvalifikasjoner.

  • Spennende prosjekter i Oslo og Akershus.

  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og langsiktig samarbeid.

  • God oppfølging fra SIBE Bemanning.

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SIBE Bemanning AS er et norsk bemanningsselskap med spesialisering innen bygg- og anleggsbransjen. Vi samarbeider med noen av de mest anerkjente entreprenørene i Oslo og Akershus og leverer kvalifiserte fagarbeidere til både små og store prosjekter.

Hos oss blir du en del av et seriøst selskap med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet og langsiktige arbeidsforhold.

title: Maskinsjef til FDA Mimmi
description:
Finnsnes Dykk & Anleggservice AS er en framoverlent maritim entreprenør som leverer servicebåt-tjenester til havbruksnæringen, entreprenører og det offentlige i Nord-Norge. Vi har ca. 70 dyktige og serviceinnstilte båtførere og matroser fordelt på 9 fartøy. I tillegg til fartøy under bygging. Vi er et rederi som stadig søker nye utviklingsmuligheter for å være med på veksten i sjømatnæringen.

Vi har behov for maskinsjef på vår servicebåt FDA Mimmi. Vi ser etter deg som har minimum M3 kompetansesertifikat. FDA Mimmi utfører en rekke ulike arbeidsoppgaver for våre kunder, hovedsakelig innenfor bygg- og anleggsvirksomhet, men også innenfor havbruksnæringen.

Du må være løsningsorientert og fleksibel, ha teknisk interesse og like å være på havet. Maskinsjef jobber tilnærmet 2/4 - turnus. Norsk er vårt arbeidsspråk.

Les mer på vår hjemmeside www.fda.no og vår Facebook-side for mer informasjon.

Kvalifikasjoner maskinist:

· Sertifikatkrav M3 eller høyere

· Gyldig helseattest

· STCW videregående sikkerhetskurs for sjøfolk

· Gjerne erfaring fra oppdrettsnæringen eller servicefartøy

Personlige egenskaper:

· Løsningsorientert og effektiv

· God arbeidskapasitet med fokus på vedlikehold

· Teknisk interesse

· Gode samarbeidsevner

Vi tilbyr:

· Spennende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver

· Konkurransedyktige betingelser

· Mulighet for personlig og faglig utvikling

· Arbeidsgiver dekker reise til og fra arbeidssted

Tiltredelse: Etter avtale.

Søknad med CV sendes til annett@fda.no innen 5. november 2026. Det er ønskelig at det oppgis 2 referanser.

For spørsmål, ta kontakt med Jørn Tore Fjellstad, tlf 977 58 480.

Finnsnes Dykk & Anleggservice AS er en framoverlent maritim entreprenør som leverer servicebåt-tjenester til havbruksnæringen, entreprenører og det offentlige i Nord-Norge. title: Indian Cook (seasonal), Street food, Tandoori, and Café-Style Cuisine
description:
Job Period: 15. April 2027 -- 30. September 2027

We are looking for an experienced cook for our golf club for the summer season of 2027! You should have solid experience in North and South Indian cuisine, as well as expertise in tandoori dishes. We are seeking someone who can contribute to our varied menu, including café food such as wraps, sandwiches, and smoothies.

Responsibilities:

• Prepare North and South Indian dishes, South Indian street food, also specializing in tandoori cuisine

• Make café food like wraps, sandwiches, smoothies, and Indian snacks

• Manage the kitchen, including inventory, hygiene, and daily routines

• Take orders, cook, and occasionally serve guests

• Follow guidelines for food preparation and serving

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in North and South Indian cuisine, particularly tandoori dishes

• Experience with Indian snacks and small dishes

• Background in catering and customer service

• Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work independently

• Flexibility to work weekends and holidays

• Experience managing kitchen inventory and maintaining high hygiene standards

We Offer:

• An exciting and varied workday in beautiful surroundings at the golf club

• Competitive salary

• Opportunity to further develop your cooking skills in a dynamic environment

Are you ready for an exciting summer job where you can showcase your skills? Send us your application and CV today!

------------------------------

Jobbperiode: 15. april 2027 -- 30. september 2027

Vi søker en erfaren kokk til vår golfklubb for sommersesongen 2027! Du bør ha solid erfaring med nord- og sørindisk matlaging, samt ekspertise innen tandooriret­ter. Vi ser etter en person som kan bidra til vår varierte meny, som også inkluderer kaféretter som wraps, sandwicher og smoothies.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

• Tilberede nord- og sørindiske retter, inkludert sørindisk gatekjøkkenmat og spesialisering i tandooriret­ter

• Lage kaféretter som wraps, sandwicher, smoothies og indiske snacks

• Ha ansvar for kjøkkenet, inkludert varebeholdning, hygiene og daglige rutiner

• Ta imot bestillinger, lage mat og av og til servere gjester

• Følge retningslinjer for matlaging og servering

Kvalifikasjoner:

• Minimum 3 års erfaring med nord- og sørindisk mat, spesielt tandooriret­ter

• Erfaring med indiske snacks og småretter

• Bakgrunn fra catering og kundeservice

• Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å jobbe selvstendig

• Fleksibilitet til å jobbe helger og helligdager

• Erfaring med kjøkkenstyring og opprettholdelse av høye hygienestandarder

Vi tilbyr:

• En spennende og variert arbeidsdag i vakre omgivelser ved golfklubben

• Konkurransedyktig lønn

• Mulighet til å videreutvikle dine kokkekunnskaper i et dynamisk miljø

Er du klar for en spennende sommerjobb der du får vist dine ferdigheter? Send oss din søknad og CV i dag!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At the clubhouse of Tyrifjord Golf Club, Avika offers a seasonal dining experience from May 1st through autumn. Located at Hamarbispenvei 81, Krokkleiva, on the beautiful Storøya in Tyrifjorden, we are the perfect retreat for both families and golf enthusiasts.

Our diverse menu includes café favorites, Indian delicacies, refreshing beverages, and ice creams---perfect for warm summer days.

På klubbhuset til Tyrifjord Golfklubb tilbyr Avika en sesongbasert matopplevelse fra 1. mai og gjennom høsten. Vi holder til i Hamarbispenvei 81, Krokkleiva , på vakre Storøya i Tyrifjorden, og er det perfekte stedet for både familier og golfentusiaster.

Vår varierte meny inkluderer kaféfavoritter, indiske delikatesser, forfriskende drikker og iskrem --- perfekt for varme sommerdager.

title: Barnehagelærer - 60% stilling - Kristiansand S
description:
Vi søker en barnehagelærer i 60% stilling fra 01.01.2027. Vi er en 2 avdelings barnehage, og du vil for det meste være på vår avdeling for barn 1-3 år sammen med 2 andre pedagoger.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en som er utdannet barnehagelærer. Vi ønsker oss en engasjert, leken og løsningsorientert kollega.

Du må ha godkjent politiattest, og gode norskkunnskaper både skriftlig og muntlig.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Barnehagelærer som sammen med pedagogiske kollegaer deler på det pedagogiske ansvaret på avdelingen. Du vil få ansvar for enkelte samlinger, foreldresamarbeid, noe planlegging og daglig drift på avdelingen.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr tre dager i uka sammen med gode kollegaer og barn som gir en meningsfull hverdag. Vi er glade i å gå på tur, er fleksible og vi er flinke til å dele oss i grupper.

Du vil komme inn på en avdeling som er godt etablert med mange ansatte som har arbeidet her over flere år.

Vi følger PBL sin tariffavtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mummidalen barnehage ble etablert i 1997, og er en toavdelingsbarnehage som ligger på Møvik i Kristiansand.

title: Barnehagelærer på Sinsen: fast 100 % i liten barnehage med 27 barn
description:
Vil du kjenne barna du jobber med, få påvirke det pedagogiske arbeidet og være del av en liten barnehage der ideer kan bli til praksis? AllCare rekrutterer nå en barnehagelærer til fast 100 % stilling hos Sinsen kirkes barnehage.

Hva vi ser etter

Du har godkjent barnehagelærerutdanning og godkjente norskferdigheter. Du liker å være tett på barna, samarbeider godt med andre og ønsker å påvirke hvordan barnehagen utvikler seg. Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt.

Oppstart fra 1. november 2026 eller etter avtale. Nysgjerrig på stillingen? Send inn en kort søknad via Superrask søknad, så tar vi kontakt for en uformell prat.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Du planlegger, gjennomfører og utvikler det pedagogiske arbeidet sammen med kollegene dine. Du bygger trygge relasjoner til barna, samarbeider godt med foresatte og bidrar til et arbeidsmiljø med varme, humor og faglig engasjement.

Den faste stillingen er som barnehagelærer. Mens en kollega er i permisjon, kan det også bli aktuelt med en midlertidig funksjon som pedagogisk leder fram til sommeren 2027. Ansvar og vilkår for dette avklares særskilt.

Vi tilbyr

Her er det bare 27 barn fordelt på to avdelinger, stor faglig og kreativ frihet og en styrer i full stilling. Vi er inspirert av Montessori og Reggio Emilia, og legger vekt på lek, kreativitet, barns medvirkning og voksne som er til stede sammen med barna.

Dette får du hos oss:

• En liten barnehage der du kan være med på å forme hverdagen

• Egen kjøkkenassistent, slik at personalet får mer tid til barna og det pedagogiske arbeidet

• En variert uteplass med egen frukt- og grønnsakshage

• Kompetanseheving og mulighet til å utvikle deg faglig

• Velferdsmidler til felles aktiviteter og støtte til helsefremmende aktiviteter

• Lønn, pensjon og forsikring etter PBLs tariffavtale

Sinsen kirkes barnehage ligger i Lørenveien 13 i Oslo. Barnehagen har utvidet kristen formålsparagraf og bygger på verdier som nestekjærlighet, tilgivelse, likeverd og ærlighet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

AllCare Solutions AS rekrutterer på vegne av Sinsen kirkes barnehage, som er arbeidsgiver for stillingen. Sinsen kirkes barnehage er en liten, veletablert barnehage i Lørenveien 13 i Oslo. Barnehagen har to avdelinger og 27 barn. Arbeidet er inspirert av Montessori og Reggio Emilia, med vekt på lek, kreativitet, barns medvirkning og trygge relasjoner. Barnehagen har utvidet kristen formålsparagraf.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Idura is looking for a Norway-based Sales Development Representative to join our team. Demand for our eID (electronic identity) solutions is growing fast, and there’s a big opportunity to help organizations integrate secure logins and digital signatures using eIDs. We want an ambitious salesperson to help us capture it.

About Idura

We help organizations securely verify users and support digital signing through eID integrations. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we also support additional European eIDs like BankID, FTN and more. Our solutions are KYC-compliant, user-friendly and aligned with standards such as PAdES and eIDAS.

In September 2024, Idura was acquired by Stø (formerly BankID BankAxept), strengthening Stø’s position in European digital identity. Stø is owned by the Norwegian banks through Vipps Holding AS. That means you get the backing of a major player, with the pace and ownership of a growing company in its early stages.

The role

As our SDR in Norway, you’ll be at the front of our growth in the Norwegian market. You’ll handle inbound leads, hunt for new ones and support the sales cycle from first contact to signed deal. You’ll be a key part of the sales team, making sure every customer gets a great experience with Idura.

You’ll also help build Idura’s presence in Norway and support the sales team with administrative tasks when needed. You’ll report to our VP of Sales, Lars Mørch, and work day to day with our Norwegian Country Manager, Håkon Tveita.

What you’ll do

  • Discover new industries, find leads, book meetings and grow the pipeline

  • Drive Idura’s growth and expansion in the Norwegian market

  • Support the sales team with administrative tasks

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years of experience in B2B Sales or Busiess Development

  • An ambitious, self-motivated person who wants to grow with the company

  • Strong business understanding

  • Fluent in Norwegian and English

  • Experience with APIs and other technical integrations is a plus

  • Experience from a similar role is a plus

Ready to apply?

We’re reviewing applications on an ongoing basis and are ready to move fast with the right candidates. If this sounds like you, don’t wait. Send in your application today. We’d love to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Idura is a Copenhagen-based company specializing in secure user authentication and digital signature solutions using electronic identities (eIDs). We empower companies to integrate eIDs into websites or applications effortlessly, ensuring an efficient, secure login or signature process at a cost-effective price. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we offer MitID as well as a range of European eIDs, including BankID in Sweden and Norway, Finnish Trust Network (FTN) and itsme in Belgium. Our mission is to ensure the highest level of security in digital verification, making the digital world a safer place to roam. Authentication We provide a fast and simple integration of eIDs for businesses that want to verify their customers on their website or app. Our solution allows your users to authenticate themselves with secure and KYC compliant eIDs, which provides the most secure and user-friendly login experience possible. Digital signatures Implement digital signatures into your workflow and sign PDF documents digitally with eIDs. We ensure that all of our digital signatures are secure and compliant with PAdES and eIDAS.

title: Kokker
description:
WE ARE HIRING -- KITCHEN TEAM Hotel St. Elisabeth / De Tre Nonner / Amalie Hotel- Tromsø

We are now hiring skilled and experienced kitchen staff to join our team at Hotel St. Elisabeth and our restaurant De Tre Nonner in Tromsø for the winter season 2026/27.

De Tre Nonner is a quality-focused restaurant with a Nordic-inspired kitchen, built around local products and suppliers. Our kitchen operates across two services:

  • Breakfast

  • Dinner -- à la carte

We are looking for passionate, reliable and team-oriented people who want to contribute to developing our kitchen and restaurant concept further.

POSITIONS AVAILABLE

1 Head Chef

1 Sous Chef

1 Cook

2 Kitchen Assistants

HEAD CHEF

FOR Amalie Hotel:

1 Kitchen Assistant

We are looking for an experienced Head Chef who can take overall responsibility for the kitchen operation at Hotel St. Elisabeth / De Tre Nonner.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years' experience as Head Chef or Sous Chef

  • Strong à la carte experience

  • Good knowledge of Nordic and quality-focused cooking

  • Leadership and team-building skills

  • Ability to work independently and take responsibility

Key responsibilities:

  • Menu development and continuous development of the restaurant concept

  • Training and coaching kitchen staff

  • Organizing work schedules and daily kitchen operations

  • Maintaining high standards of quality and presentation

  • IK-MAT food safety routines

  • Ordering and stock control

  • Monitoring and controlling food costs

  • Building and developing a strong kitchen team

The Head Chef will have the opportunity to shape the concept and menu at De Tre Nonner and build their own team in a small, close-knit operation with short decision paths and a real opportunity to influence daily operations.

COOKS & KITCHEN ASSISTANTS

We are looking for:

Cook

  • Experience from à la carte operations

  • Passion for quality food and good ingredients

  • Ability to work efficiently in a busy kitchen

  • Reliable and team-oriented

Kitchen Assistants

  • Previous kitchen experience is an advantage

  • Reliable, hardworking and willing to learn

  • Positive attitude and ability to contribute to a good working environment

WE OFFER

  • Seasonal position from mid-November 2026 to the end of March 2027

  • Accommodation available

  • A quality-focused kitchen operation with ambitions

  • Workplace in Tromsø

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Opportunity to influence and develop our restaurant concept

  • A small and close-knit team with short decision paths

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Come join us at Hotel St. Elisabeth and De Tre Nonner in Tromsø for the winter season 2026/27!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Enter Tromsø is a fully-owned family company in Northern Norway that is growing, with over 150,000 guest nights per year and approximately 100 employees. Enter Tromsø is part of a group that develops values in property and tourism in Northern Norway. We are driven by making a difference in society and providing extraordinary customer experiences through innovation and sustainable choices. With us, you have the opportunity to create golden moments in encounters with our guests from various customer groups. We offer good career opportunities, training and development, as well as favorable employee benefits and discounts.

title: Helsefagarbeider - 78,4 % vikariat, Hemnes hjemmetjenester
description:
Bli med på laget og bidra til fremtidens helsetjenester!

Vi søker engasjert og omsorgsfull helsefagarbeider som ønsker å bidra til gode og trygge tjenester for våre pasienter i hjemmetjenesten.

Hemnes hjemmetjeneste består av sykepleiere, helsefagarbeidere, hjelpepleiere og assistenter som sammen jobber for å gi trygge og kvalitetsmessig gode tjenester til våre pasienter. Vi utfører tjenester både til innbyggere som bor i egen bolig og til beboere ved Ulvehaugen omsorgsbolig. Vårt arbeid bygger på spørsmålet «Hva er viktig for deg?», og vi har et sterkt søkelys på brukermedvirkning, mestring og kvalitet i tjenestene.

Vi har ledig følgende stilling:

  • Helsefagarbeider – 78,4 % vikariat med for tiden arbeid hver 3.helg. Stillingen kan utvides med hinkehelg.
  • Ledig fra dags dato – 31.08.27 med mulighet for forlengelse.

Hos oss møter du engasjerte kollegaer, godt samarbeid på tvers av faggrupper, muligheter for faglig utvikling og ikke minst en god dose humor i hverdagen. Vi tror at et godt arbeidsmiljø er en viktig forutsetning for å kunne gi gode tjenester.

Aurskog-Høland kommune har i dag fire distrikter innen hjemmetjenesten: Hemnes, Rømskog, Bjørkelangen og Aurskog. Vi står nå foran en spennende omorganisering av hjemmetjenesten, der vi skal se på distriktsstruktur og oppgavedeling for å møte fremtidens behov og utfordringer på en best mulig måte.

Vi håper du har lyst til å være med på denne reisen. Velkommen som søker hos oss!

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bidra til å styrke brukers egne ressurser for å ivareta eget liv og helse
  • Dekke grunnleggende behov hos bruker som ikke er i stand til dette selv
  • Veilede, undervise og informere pasienter, deres pårørende, studenter, lærlinger og kollegaer
  • Planlegge selvstendig og ta raske avgjørelser
  • Gjøre kliniske vurderinger og observere fortløpende brukers helhetlige tilstand
  • Vurdere bruk av velfersteknologi og iverksette denne
  • Dokumentasjon

 Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider/hjelpepleier.
  • Relevant erfaring fra pleie- og omsorgsarbeid vil bli vektlagt.
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Førerkort klasse B.
  • Norskkunnskaper minimum nivå B2 (gjelder søkere med annet morsmål enn norsk).

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Selvstendig og fleksibel med gode samarbeidsevner
  • Ser muligheter og er løsningsorientert. Jobber strukturert og systematisk
  • Positiv, ansvarsfull, engasjert og endringsvillig
  • Bidrar til et godt miljø for beboere, pårørende og kollegaer
  • Er faglig engasjert

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø og hyggelige kollegaer.
  • Kommunen har gode betingelser i forbindelse med helgearbeid.

Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt ved alle ansettelser.

Politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse.

Vår visjon er muligheter, miljø og mangfold. Sammen gjør vi det umulige mulig, velger grønt først og lar ulikhetene forme vår felles fremtid. Vi har et ansvar for fortid, nåtid og skaper et samfunn i takt med sin samtid, og vi legger til rette for at Aurskog-Høland er et godt sted å leve, bo og arbeide.

Våre verdier som ligger til grunn for alt arbeid som skjer i kommunen er; Åpenhet, Tillit og Samhandling.

Etter søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste, i samsvar med Offentleglova § 25. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Søkere vil bli varslet i forkant dersom anmodning om unntak fra offentlighet ikke tas til følge.

Alle attester/tjenestebevis og vitnemål må lastes opp sammen med søknad og CV i rekrutteringsportalen, EasyCruit innen søknadsfristen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra HK-dir. https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet

Ønskes ytterligere opplysninger om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med virksomhetsleder på Hemnes hjemmetjenester, Marthe Glende Aannerud, på e-post: marthe.glende.aannerud@ahk.no eller telefon 940 17 530.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kommunen ligger under en time fra Oslo, Gardermoen og Charlottenberg, og kun 30 minutter fra Lillestrøm og store deler av Romerike. Vi er Oslos nærmeste villmark med et rikt dyreliv og et flott kulturlandskap, og med flere tettsteder der Bjørkelangen er kommunesenteret. Aurskog-Høland kommune er en fremtidsrettet organisasjon der medarbeiderne er den viktigste ressursen for at vi skal lykkes i å skape det mangfoldige og gode liv for våre innbyggere og gjester. Det gjør vi best sammen, og som ansatt er vi opptatt av å gi deg ansvar og spennende arbeidsoppgaver, samtidig som vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling. Aurskog-Høland ble som én av tre kommuner nominert som Årets kulturkommune 2023-2024, ligger på første plass på Romerike i saksbehandling av byggesaker, og havnet i 2022 på 14. plass over landets best styrte kommuner. Vi ønsker oss flere initiativrike og dyktige medarbeidere som setter pris på å bli utfordret og som aktivt bidrar i løsningen av kommunens oppgaver. Vi er en kommune i vekst. Det gir oss mange muligheter i tiden fremover. Vi kan tilby spennende og utviklende oppgaver.

title: vi har ledig 2 100% vikariat som
description:
Bardu kommune med sine 4000 innbyggere ligger i vakre omgivelser sentralt i Indre Troms. Bardu har mange friluftsmuligheter, godt utbygd idrettsanlegg og et godt tjenestetilbud. Næringslivet kan friste med nye spisesteder og god handelsstand. 

Kommunens visjon er: Trivsel og kvalitet i friske omgivelser. 

Bo og oppfølging er en avdeling med ulike tjenesteområder som trenger engasjerte, faglig trygge og selvstendige medarbeidere. Vi jobber hver dag med å skape de beste tjenestene for våre tjenestemottakere og det beste arbeidsmiljøet for vårt medarbeiderskap. I dette arbeidet trenger vi flere positive, selvstendige og løsningsorienterte medarbeidere. Er det nettopp deg?

Stillingen er knyttet til «Bekkebo bo,- og avlastningssenter» tilknyttet unge voksne med utviklingshemming, og «Vekved bokollektiv» for mennesker med utviklingshemming. Avdelingen er godt etablert og som yter tjenester til mennesker med psykisk utviklingshemming, utviklingsforrstyrrelser og andre sosialt utfordringer. Vi yter tjenester i form av hjemmestjenester og vårt primære arbeidsoppdrag er å yte grunnleggende omsorg av høy kvalitet. I tillegg skal det tilrettelegges for trening og utvikling i dagliglivets ferdigheter. Dette gjøres ved å skape forutsigbarhet og struktur. 

Vi er særlig opptatt av at den enkelte tjenestemottaker skal ha et individuelt tilpasset tjenestetilbud og at våre medarbeidere skal ha et trygt, godt og utviklende arbeidsmiljø. 

Turnusordning: tredelt turnus, med arbeid hver tredje helg, nattevakter inngår.

Er dette noe for deg? Og kan du være med på å bidra til å løfte våre tjenester? Vi har fokus på god kvalitet i veien frem mot vår måloppnåelse.  

Vi har ledig:

2 vikariat i 100% stilling som sykepleier/vernepleier/helsefararbeider/barne- og ungdomsarbeider, med mulighet for forlengelse. 

Varighet:

08.02.2027 - 31.12.2027

15.02.2027 - 31.12.2027

Bardu Kommune har vedtatt en egen plan for å rekruttere og beholde. For å rekruttere nye sykepleiere/vernepleiere gir vi ett rekrutteringstilskudd på 50.000 kr med bindingstid på 2 år. I tillegg utbetales 10.000 kr til årslønn for sykepleiere/vernepleiere/helsefagarbeidere/barne-og ungdomsarbeidere.

Bardu kommune er en del av sentralitetssone 5. Dette gir mulighet for sletting av studielån hos Lånekassen med kr 25.000,- pr. år etter gjeldende retningslinjer. 

Kommunens visjon er: Trivsel og kvalitet i friske omgivelser.

title: Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding
employer: NORGES MILJØ- OG BIOVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET (NMBU) CAMPUS ÅS
description:
About the position

Be part of the future with NMBU!

The Department of Plant Sciences (IPV), Faculty of Biosciences, at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) has a vacancy for a permanent 100% position as Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding.

We are looking for an ambitious researcher and dedicated educator to strengthen NMBU's internationally recognized research and education in plant genetics, population genetics, and plant breeding with a focus on forage crops. This position represents a strategic investment in one of the department's core academic disciplines and will play a key role in educating the next generation of plant breeders and geneticists while advancing research that contributes to sustainable agriculture and future food security.

The successful candidate is expected to establish an internationally competitive research group within population genetics and plant breeding, with particular emphasis on quantitative genetics, breeding methodologies, genomics, genetic diversity, and the breeding of outcrossing crops. As part of our academic team, you will teach and supervise Bachelor, Master, and PhD students, contribute to attracting competitive national and international research funding, and strengthen collaborations with breeding companies, research institutes, and universities in Norway and abroad. 

You will play a leading role in further developing our educational portfolio within genetics and plant breeding and contribute to innovative teaching methods and student-active learning.

The successful candidate will become part of a highly interdisciplinary research environment with close collaboration across the Department of Plant Sciences, the Faculty of Biosciences, and other faculties at NMBU. The position also offers opportunities to contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives in population genetics, genomics, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient agriculture, supporting both plant and animal science communities.

We are proud to educate highly skilled graduates and to conduct research with a strong societal impact. We are looking for candidates who combine scientific excellence with a passion for teaching, collaboration, and innovation. We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who will help shape the future of genetics and plant breeding at NMBU.

Main tasks

The successful candidate is expected to

  • Conduct research of the highest international standard and strengthen research in population genetics, genomics, genomic selection, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient crop development.
  • Publish regularly in peer-reviewed international journals.
  • Contribute to both basic and applied research.
  • Secure external funding from national and international funding agencies, including Horizon Europe and the Research Council of Norway.
  • Supervise PhD, MSc and BSc students.
  • Contribute to innovation and collaboration with industry and breeding organization. 
  • Network and collaborate within and outside NMBU and actively participate in interdisciplinary research initiatives across NMBU.
  • Contribute to the strategic development of plant genetics and breeding activities at the department.
  • Develop and deliver high-quality teaching in population genetics, plant breeding, quantitative genetics, genomics, and bioinformatics for plant breeding across Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programmes.
  • Contribute to educational excellence through student supervision, curriculum development, pedagogical innovation, and the implementation of research-based teaching and modern digital learning approaches.
  • Conduct administrative tasks and other joint tasks at the faculty in collaboration with colleagues and students.
Competence

All qualifications below are required for the position, unless it is specified that they are considered an advantage. 

Academic qualifications:

  • A PhD in Plant Breeding, Population Genetics, Plant Science, or other fields related to the described position.
  • Ability to develop and lead internationally recognized research within the subject area.
  • Competence and experience with genetic research on forage crops.
  • Experience in planning and conducting field experiments.
  • Documented research output / publication record such as international peer-reviewed publications in relevant scientific journals, books, and research reports within population genetics and plant breeding.
  • Experience with research relevant to Nordic agricultural conditions is considered an advantage
  • Experience with research leadership is considered as an advantage

Educational qualifications (documented):

  • Pedagogical education completed separate program at minimum 200 hours*.
  • Teaching experience from higher education.
  • Supervision experience.
  • Basic teaching skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and development of own teaching and supervision.
  • Experience with educational leadership is considered an advantage.*Those who do not meet the educational qualification at the time of employment shall be required to meet them within two years of employment.

Applied knowledge, among others

  • Experience with dissemination is considered an advantage.
  • Experience with industry collaboration is considered as an advantage.

Management, committees and boards and administration, among others

  • Experience with management, committees and boards and administration is considered an advantage.

Special qualifications, among others

  • Good written and oral communication skills in a Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language) and English is a prerequisite for performing the duties of the position.

Personal qualities, among others

  • Outstanding collaborative and communicative skills both to the scientific community and to a broader community.
  • Strong, professional commitment to excellence in teaching.
  • Ability to realize scientific synergies between individual researchers and research groups.
  • Strong potential for independent thinking displaying initiative and careful creative thought.
  • Experience with building and maintaining a productive and energized research group.
Remuneration and further information

The position is placed in position code 1011 Associate Professor (NOK 720 000 – 1 100 000) depending on qualifications. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Seniority promotion in the position. 

Interested in learning more about the position? We are happy to tell you more about life on campus. Contact Section leader and researcher Sahameh Shafiee, tel:  +4767232769, (e-mail: sahameh.shafiee@nmbu.no). 

General information for applicants

Application

Send application electronically via the link "Apply for this job" at the top of this page. 

Application Deadline: : November 20th, 2026

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge's CV form and not just included as an attachment. This is in order to be able to comply with the regulations in the Public Administration Act §15.

The following must be included in the application:

  • Short application text about your motivation
  • Reflective statement (3–6 pages) addressing your reflections on the requirements of the position (see the job advertisement).
  • Academic CV, diplomas and certificates
  • Completed template for documentation of competence, link to template here.
  • List of publications. Attach up to 15 scientific works that, according to assessment, are central to the production. If it is difficult to identify personal efforts in joint work, a brief account of your part of the work must be attached.

NMBU has developed a matrix for assessing qualifications, which provides examples of results/competence, documentation, and reflection for all areas of the competence profile. We encourage you to familiarize yourself with the matrix and use it when applying for the position. See this page for more information on how to document your qualifications and write a reflection note.

Documents that cannot be sent electronically are sent in triplicate by ordinary mail marked still.nr. 26/09329 to NMBU, Faculty of Biosciences, P.O. Box 5003, NO-1432 Ås, within 20.11.2026.

Please note that the report from the expert committee will be sent to all applicants.

About The Faculty of Biosciences

The Faculty of Biosciences (BIOVIT) aims to shape the future of food and bioproduction through teaching and research in biology and sustainable production and use of plants, livestock and fish. The faculty has a large project portfolio and an annual turnover of approximately NOK 250 million. 

BIOVIT is organized into seven research groups: Genome Biology, Breeding, Genetics and Food Production Systems, Ruminant Nutrition and Physiology, Ethology and Animal Welfare, Nutrition and Physiology for Monogastric Animals, Plant Biology, Sustainable Food Systems and Integrated Plant Protection, and Genetics, Evolution and Sustainable Plant Production. Additionally, the faculty has seven research support and laboratory units.

BIOVIT is responsible for bachelor’s and master’s programs in aquaculture, biology, animal science, and plant science, as well as English-language master’s programs in Agroecology, Plant Sciences, Feed Manufacturing Technology, and Genome Sciences. BIOVIT also offers Ph.D. programs in animal science and plant science. Currently, the faculty has about 550 bachelor’s and master’s students and 90 Ph.D. students. BIOVIT employs approximately 230 staff members and has its own faculty administration.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NMBU will contribute to securing the future of life through outstanding research, education, communication and innovation. We have the country's most satisfied university students, who receive research-based education in a unique student environment. Our graduates gain a high level of competence in interdisciplinary collaboration and are popular in the labor market.

NMBU has internationally leading research environments in several subjects. Together with our partners in society and business, we contribute to solving some of the biggest societal challenges of our time. We focus on innovation, communication and entrepreneurship because we believe these challenges are best solved with joint efforts. We believe that a good working environment is characterized by diversity.If necessary, workplace adaptations will be made for persons with disabilities. More information about NMBU is available at www.nmbu.no/en

title: PhD Candidate - Hydrogen and Industrial Decarbonization Pathways
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

We invite applications for a 3-year PhD Candidate position on the future role of hydrogen and hydrogen products in industrial decarbonization. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT) is to carry out education, research, and innovation activities at an international level at the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE. The department’s activities aim to contribute to sustainable value creation within technology-based areas in industry, business, and the public sector in Norway

 

About the position

Electrification is widely promoted as a key pathway to industrial decarbonization. At the same time, hydrogen and carbon capture and storage (CCS) are increasingly recognized as important solutions for sectors where direct electrification may be difficult or uneconomic. This has led to a growing debate about the future role of "electrons versus molecules" in a net-zero economy.

Most existing studies assume that today's industrial structure remains largely unchanged and focus on how current industries can reduce emissions. However, deep decarbonization may fundamentally reshape industrial production, value chains, competitiveness, and the location of energy-intensive activities. As a result, future hydrogen demand may depend as much on industrial transformation as on technological choices.

This PhD project will investigate how alternative pathways toward a zero-emission industrial sector affect the future demand for hydrogen and the development of hydrogen value chains. The research will analyze the interplay between electrification, hydrogen, and CCS, while explicitly accounting for potential changes in industrial structures and production systems.

 

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How will future hydrogen demand vary across alternative industrial decarbonization pathways?
  • Which industrial sectors are likely to rely on electrification, hydrogen, or CCS to achieve net-zero emissions?
  • How might industrial transformation affect hydrogen production, transport, storage, and trade?
  • What level of hydrogen deployment is required to justify dedicated hydrogen infrastructure and markets?
  • How can Europe and Norway prepare for different industrial and energy-system transition pathways?

 

The successful candidate will develop and analyze future scenarios for industrial transformation, hydrogen demand, and infrastructure development. The project will contribute to the scientific and policy debate on how competitive zero-emission industries can emerge under different transition strategies.

Research environment

The PhD candidate will join a multidisciplinary research environment at the intersection of energy economics, industrial economics, operations research, and energy systems analysis.

The position is affiliated with FME HYDROGENi, the Norwegian Research and Innovation Centre for Hydrogen and Ammonia. The centre brings together 46 research and industry partners to develop the knowledge, technologies, and solutions needed to support a sustainable hydrogen economy and contribute to Norway's ambitions for climate neutrality and industrial transformation. FME HYDROGENi conducts research across the hydrogen value chain, including hydrogen production, transport and storage, industrial and maritime applications, safety, and the broader role of hydrogen in future energy systems. The centre is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Centres for Environment-friendly Energy Research (FME) programme and operates during the period 2022-2030

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project

The PhD candidate will:

  • Conduct original scientific research on hydrogen and industrial decarbonization pathways.
  • Develop and analyze scenarios for industrial transformation and climate neutrality.
  • Assess the future role of electrification, hydrogen, and CCS across industrial sectors.
  • Quantify hydrogen demand and infrastructure requirements under alternative transition pathways.
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences.
  • Collaborate with academic, industry, and public-sector partners.
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme.
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research findings.

 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU’s grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:

  • Operations research or optimization
  • Energy systems
  • Energy Economics
  • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Or other closely related disciplines.

Applicants must demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative skills.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with energy system modelling, scenario analysis, or techno-economic analysis.
  • Knowledge of hydrogen technologies, industrial decarbonization, or climate policy.
  • Experience with quantitative modelling and data analysis.
  • Programming skills in Python, Julia, R, GAMS, or similar tools.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of technology, economics, and policy.

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in an interdisciplinary research environment. 
  • Is interested in research with relevance for industry, policy, and society.

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Close collaboration with leading researchers in energy systems modelling, optimization, and something else 
  • Opportunities to engage with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in research addressing key challenges of the green transition.
  • Opportunities for international research stays and conference participation.
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU 

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

 

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of at least two potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI).

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates.  

NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public applicant list with names, ages, job titles, and municipalities of residence will be prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to reserve yourself from being included on the public applicant list, this must be justified. The assessment will be made in accordance with applicable laws. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is Norway's technology capital with a population of over 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens, and general equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized childcare is readily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers excellent educational opportunities (including international schools) and opportunities to enjoy nature, culture, and family life, with low crime rates and clean air quality.

Questions about the position can be directed to Professor Asgeir Tomasgard (asgeir.tomasgard @ntnu.no) or Professor Anne Neumann (anne.neumann@ntnu.no).

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Oddny Lyngvær at oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no.

 

An application including attachments should be sent electronically through www.jobbnorge.no

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.
