title: Storage DevSecOps Engineer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team     Join us to build, and run the storage services behind Ericsson R&D  Reliable storage helps Ericsson’s research and development teams design, test and deliver what’s next. Join the RCE NES Data Storage team and help evolve the services and infrastructure they depend on, from design and implementation to secure, dependable day-to-day operations.  This is an opportunity in our Data Storage team. We welcome recent graduates and candidates with up to around five years of relevant experience in storage systems or DevOps. You don’t need to be a security specialist: we’re looking for someone who wants to build and operate services with security built in. DevOps and infrastructure candidates are encouraged to apply.  What you’ll do  •    Turn requirements into practical, cost-effective storage service designs, and contribute to service architecture and improvements. •    Help install, configure, upgrade, patch, repair and retire storage hardware and software, primarily in on-premises environments, with growing connections to hybrid cloud. •    Automate repeatable tasks and improve how services are delivered and operated. •    Support service availability through proactive monitoring, alerts, audit and log reviews, and 2nd- and 3rd-line troubleshooting. •    Coordinate data migrations and work with users, operations teams, suppliers and vendors to deliver changes and resolve issues. •    Take part in asset, change, incident, problem and request handling; help manage access, identities, certificates and security zones. •    Apply Ericsson security requirements and good practice through risk and security assessments, quality assurance and business continuity planning. •    Keep service, system, project and operating documentation current; identify risks and impediments and suggest better ways of working.    Skills you’ll bring  •    A BSc or MSc in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or a related field—or equivalent knowledge. •    Relevant experience, study or hands-on projects in storage, infrastructure, systems administration or DevOps; early-career applicants are very welcome. •    Interest in storage technologies such as SAN, NAS, DAS and cloud storage, and protocols such as SCSI, NFS or SMB. •    Familiarity with platforms such as NetApp, Dell, Pure or HPE, or the motivation to learn them. •    Interest in scripting and automation. Python, PowerShell and Ansible are useful; other languages and tools are welcome. •    A service-minded approach to reliability, security and ownership, plus clear communication and documentation skills in English. •    A collaborative, curious, can-do attitude and care for well-built services.    Experience with virtualization, containers, cloud, microservices, software architecture, agile development or continuous integration is beneficial, not essential.    Why Ericsson Lab Operations?  Work with an open team supporting services used by R&D around the world. You’ll contribute across the service lifecycle, collaborate with stakeholders and suppliers, and help make storage more reliable, secure and efficient.  Security clearance, references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

description: Company description:Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."Job description:  We are seeking a talented Data Architect and Modeler to develop and govern consistent, scalable data architecture for Volvo Group Master Data Management. In this role, you will create and evolve enterprise-level data models, ensure consistency and accuracy across domains, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support Volvo Group’s ambition to become a truly data-driven company.     Key Responsibilities:       Define and drive the Master Data architecture strategy and technical roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives, Volvo design principles, and long-term data platform goals.     Design and govern scalable, secure, and high-performing data architectures, establishing frameworks, standards, and governance processes that ensure data quality, consistency, compliance, and efficient data flows.     Own and evolve the Volvo Group Data Model (VGDM) for the Unified Data Platform, including lifecycle management, scope definition, backlog prioritization, and alignment with business and platform needs.     Lead the design and integration of conceptual, logical, and physical data models, mapping business concepts and source data to the Teradata mLDM structure and enabling effective integration of data from multiple sources for analytics and decision-making.     Collaborate with Master Data architects and cross-functional stakeholders to define data architecture standards and ensure alignment across engineering, analytics, application development, and platform teams.     Review, govern, and integrate data model changes, maintaining strong quality controls and ensuring consistency across data models, business glossaries, and governance frameworks.     Drive continuous improvement of data products, technologies, data designs, and data flows, partnering with the central platform organization to enhance data capabilities and accelerate business value.        Who are you?       You want to take your career to the next level, working with amazing people worldwide. You are passionate about defining and designing end-to-end scalable data solutions, ensuring they align with enterprise architecture and industry standards.     Have 5+ years of experience in data modeling, with a strong grasp of both normalized and de-normalized data models to support scalable, high-quality data solutions.     You are proficient in data analysis, familiar with the Teradata Vantage Data Model (or similar), and can work in an agile environment.     You have a university degree or equivalent and several years of experience as a data architect practitioner especially in Azure's full suite of services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and practical understanding of DBT Framework.       The right candidate can think and act strategically, operate tactically, and implement change effectively, managing change priorities in a business-focused, fact-based, and collaborative way to achieve real impact.       As this is a leading role, there will be next to the technical focus, also a strong focus on soft skills. We expect someone very structured and works fact-based and can defend her/his points of view to challenging stakeholders.          Union representatives for Swedish applicants:  Akademikerna – Mikael Johansson, +46 73 9023430 Unionen – Lajla Dahlsjö, +46 31 3224575 Ledarna – Carina Sachade, +46 73 9024083        We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.                    We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.   Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO) is a new division established to integrate the capabilities of VG Digital & IT and VG Connected Solutions to accelerate the digital transformation in Volvo Group. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.   Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. We put people first and build our culture on trust, passion, customer success, change, and performance. If you want to grow, collaborate across functions and entities, and help shape the future of digital products within Volvo Group, DTO is a great place to be.

title: Håll X2000-tågen i rörelse - bli tågtekniker hos EuroMaint Olskroken
description: Företagsbeskrivning:Är du mekaniker, elektriker, servicetekniker eller arbetar du med tekniskt underhåll idag? Nu söker EuroMaint flera nya tågtekniker till vårt X2-team i Olskroken. Hos oss får du arbeta med avancerad teknik, felsökning och underhåll av Sveriges snabbaste tåg i en modern verkstadsmiljö. Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet från järnvägsbranschen. Har du teknisk kompetens, ett stort engagemang och viljan att utvecklas erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att bygga en långsiktig karriär inom en framtidsbransch. På grund av ökad verksamhet stärker vi nu vårt team och söker flera nya kollegor.Arbetsbeskrivning: Om rollen  Som tågtekniker hos oss blir du en viktig del av det dagliga underhållet av X2-tågen. Du arbetar i vår moderna depå i Olskroken och ansvarar för att tågen håller högsta standard när det gäller säkerhet, funktion och tillgänglighet. Rollen är varierande och kombinerar praktiskt arbete med tekniskt tänkande, felsökning och kontinuerliga förbättringar. Du arbetar både med planerat underhåll och felavhjälpning, ofta i nära samarbete med engagerade kollegor. Tillsammans säkerställer ni att tågen snabbt och säkert kan återgå i trafik. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:      Utföra förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll på X2-tåg     Felsöka och reparera mekaniska, hydrauliska, elektriska och pneumatiska system     Genomföra kontroller, byten och justeringar enligt underhållsplaner     Dokumentera utfört arbete i våra underhållssystem     Säkerställa att arbetet utförs enligt gällande säkerhets- och kvalitetskrav     Delta i förbättringsarbete för ökad driftsäkerhet och effektivitet    Din profil Vi söker dig som har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och trivs med praktiskt arbete i en tekniskt avancerad miljö. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har säkerhet som en självklar del av ditt arbetssätt. Du kanske arbetar idag som mekaniker, underhållstekniker, servicetekniker, elektriker eller har erfarenhet från industri-, fordons- eller verkstadsbranschen. Tidigare erfarenhet av järnväg är meriterande men inget krav. Vi välkomnar både dig som har flera års erfarenhet av tekniskt underhåll och dig som är nyutbildad med ett starkt tekniskt intresse och vilja att utvecklas inom yrket. Vi ser att du har:      Teknisk gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet     Erfarenhet av tekniskt eller mekaniskt arbete     God förmåga att arbeta självständigt och i team     Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift  Meriterande:      Erfarenhet av arbete med järnvägsfordon     Elkompetens och vana att läsa elscheman     Erfarenhet av felsökning i komplexa tekniska system     Kunskap inom hydraulik eller pneumatik  Förmåner & erbjudande Hos EuroMaint får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en framtidsbransch där teknik och hållbara transporter står i fokus.   Vi erbjuder:        Friskvårdsbidrag på 4 000 kr per år         Ersättning för läkarkostnader och receptbelagd medicin upp till högkostnadsskyddet         Gratis mensskydd på alla våra arbetsplatser   På EuroMaint erbjuder vi en tydlig karriär- och lönemodell för våra tågtekniker. Rollen är indelad i flera nivåer, vilket innebär att du kan utvecklas och befordras inom yrket i takt med att du växer, tar större ansvar och breddar din kompetens.     Plats & omfattning Plats: Olskroken, Göteborg Omfattning: Heltid Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse Arbetstider: Skiftarbete förekommer Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders provanställning Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi Master-tester OPTO och CORE för att få en rättvis och objektiv bedömning av dina färdigheter. Vi gör en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning erbjuds. Då denna tjänst är säkerhetsklassad ingår även en hälsoundersökning i rekryteringsprocessen, denna bekostas av oss. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.  Profilbeskrivning:Om EuroMaint EuroMaint erbjuder kvalificerat tekniskt underhåll på spårbundna fordon som tillgodoser kundernas behov av väl fungerande fordonsflottor. Vi har ett nät av verkstäder från Luleå i norr till Malmö i söder, samt två verkstäder i Norge. Huvudkontoret är placerat i Solna. Hos oss arbetar många specialister inom underhåll av järnvägsfordon. EuroMaint har en omsättning på ca 1 900 MSEK och cirka 1 100 medarbetare (2024). EuroMaint ägs av den börsnoterade spanska tågtillverkaren CAF sedan juli 2019.  Våra värderingar: Professionalism – hög kvalitet, innovation och ansvar Samarbete – tillsammans når vi bättre resultat Säkerhet – alltid högsta prioritet

title: Head of Strategic Insights & Industry Marketing
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.   We are looking for a Head of Strategic Insights & Industry Marketing for the Food & Pharma Division. We are dedicated to helping billions of people access nutritious food, clean water, and safe medicine. We pioneer technologies and solutions for life-critical industries, including food, pharmaceutical, and water sectors, enabling our customers to produce more while using less water, energy, and valuable raw materials.  About the job The Head of Strategic Insights & Industry Marketing plays a key role in shaping market-driven growth priorities for the Food & Pharma Division. Working closely with divisional leadership, strategic business developers, and stakeholders across the organization, the role translates market, customer, competitive, and industry insights into commercial opportunities and strategic initiatives.  Reporting to the VP Marketing, this role drives divisional industry marketing strategies across priority verticals, supports business planning and growth prioritization, and ensures marketing contributes directly to revenue growth, competitive positioning, and long-term business expansion. Success requires the ability to connect strategic insight with commercial execution in a complex international B2B environment.  The role also leads the division’s industry marketing agenda across priority industries, ensuring alignment between growth priorities, customer engagement, and marketing execution. Key Responsibilities Planning & prioritization     Lead and coordinate industry marketing and related business planning across the Division, Business Units, and regional sales companies.     Support growth prioritization by translating market, customer, and competitive insights into strategic implications and actions.     Ensure cross-functional alignment across marketing, sales, and business stakeholders.  Insights & Analytics Leadership     Drive the division’s insights excellence agenda and foster a data-informed culture.     Translate market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive dynamics into decisions and actions.     Lead a team of Industry Marketing Managers and Intelligence Analysts.     Ensure insights are turned into actionable industry marketing strategies, campaigns, and customer engagement initiatives.  Strategic Industry Marketing     Develop and drive divisional industry marketing strategies across priority verticals to support growth, differentiation, and market leadership.     Lead the division’s industry marketing agenda across key industries, ensuring alignment between priorities and commercial execution.     Translate customer needs, industry trends, and market dynamics into impactful positioning, value propositions, and growth initiatives.     Support cross-BU alignment around key industry opportunities, growth platforms, and priorities.     Drive prioritization and alignment of divisional industry marketing initiatives to ensure focus, scalability, and commercial impact across Business Units and Sales Companies.  Revenue & Growth Focus     Ensure marketing contributes directly to revenue growth, profitability, and key business KPIs through customer insight, market understanding, and business-oriented analysis.     Identify and pursue new business opportunities, market adjacencies, and growth areas across priority industries.  Cross-Functional Collaboration     Collaborate across the marketing organization to align industry strategies, customer engagement initiatives, and divisional priorities.     Lead and develop strategic industry marketing capabilities and insights across the division.   Who you are     Proven track record of turning market insights into measurable business impact and commercial growth.     Strong background in strategic marketing, market intelligence, business analysis, competitive intelligence, and customer insight.     Strong business acumen with the ability to connect strategic insight to commercial growth.     Experience in complex international B2B environments, preferably in industrial, food, pharma, process technology, or related industries.     Experience in management consulting and market intelligence is an advantage.     Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment.     Experience leading teams and working across diverse marketing and business functions.     Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.   What you know     Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, or related field.     8+ years of experience in strategic marketing, market intelligence, industry marketing, or related roles.     4+ years of leadership experience in a managerial capacity.     Analytical skills and proficiency with market intelligence and analytics methodologies.     Experience working in international matrix organizations with multiple stakeholders and business units.     Demonstrated success in international matrix organizations.   This position is preferably based at our Stockholm (Flemingsberg) office. The role includes an expected travel commitment of a couple of days per month.

title: Lärare i fritidshem sökes till Surteskolan!
description: Vi söker dig som vill vara med och forma morgondagens Ale. Hos oss är du med och levererar service och tjänster av bästa kvalitet till Aleborna. Tillsammans skapar 2 500 medarbetare ett Ale, kommunen som fokuserar på invånarna och deras behov. Bli en av oss!Om arbetsplatsenSurteskolan står inför ett omtag och en rejäl satsning på fritidshemmets verksamhet - vi söker lärare i fritidshem som kan vara med och leda denna förändring!Surteskolan är en F-6 skola som ligger precis norr om Göteborg. Skolan är vackert belägen på en kulle omgiven av skog och har cirka 200 elever. Utmärkande för Surteskolan är våra små klasser om 17-22 elever i varje och ett litet men sammansvetsat arbetslag på fritids. Fritidshemmet är organiserat i två avdelningar men jobbar som ett gemensamt arbetslag. Vi är en liten skola och har nära till varandra. Pedagogisk personal, elevhälsa, administration, städ och kost är i ständig dialog för att hitta bra lösningar för  våra elever.Surteskolan ligger tillräckligt nära Göteborg för att räknas till zon A med Västtrafik. Pendeltåget tar dig från Centralstationen till Surte på 10 minuter.ArbetsuppgifterVi söker dig som har ett stort engagemang för att utveckla en modern verksamhet där vi har fokus på att ständigt öka kvaliteten i undervisningen. Du ska axla ansvaret som ledare för en verksamhet som ständigt behöver ta nästa steg och utvecklas tillsammans med sina elever.Uppdraget i fritidshemmet förenar omsorg med pedagogik och du inspirerar eleverna att utforska, lära, och erövra nya intressen tillsammans med andra i fritidshemmets verksamhet. Under skoltid kommer du arbeta i klass och beroende på din behörighet planera och genomföra egna lektioner. En viktig del av uppdraget är kommunikation med vårdnadshavare kring fritidshemmets verksamhet, men också kring utmaningar som uppstår, exempelvis konflikter mellan eleverna. Som lärare i fritidshem arbetar du medvetet med din kommunikation för att bidra till att alla får chans att lyckas på fritids.På Surteskolan värdesätter vi förmågan att skapa goda relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. KvalifikationerVi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem eller som har pågående studier för att få legitimation. Erfarenhet av arbete i fritidshemmet är ett krav.Särskilt meriterande vore behörighet i bild och/eller hem- och konsumentkunskap.Du har god kännedom om fritidshemmets nationella styrdokument och skapar trygga relationer till elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Med ett positivt förhållningssätt utgår du från elevens förmåga att utvecklas socialt och kunskapsmässigt och har ett nära samarbete med andra pedagoger på skolan.Du har en tydlig kommunikation, förstår vikten av att vara en lagspelare samt bidrar med en positiv anda. Du är flexibel, initiativrik och har ett lösningsorienterat verksamhetsfokus med elevens utveckling och bästa i fokus.Förutom behörighet kommer stor vikt att läggas på goda chefsreferenser.Om du känner igen dig i beskrivningen och vill vara en del av vårt team skicka in din ansökan idag!ÖvrigtIntervjuer kommer att ske löpande. Tjänsterna tillsätts om ingen internsökande gör anspråk på tjänsten.  Om legitimation ej kan uppvisas innan anställning erbjuds vikariat på upp till ett år istället.Giltigt utdrag från belastningsregister ska visas upp, via digital brevlåda via mejl eller till ansvarig rekryterare när ni träffas i slutfasen (utdraget ska vara giltigt inom 1 år)Ansökningsblanketten hittar du här: Skola eller förskola, e-tjänst | PolismyndighetenVår värdegrund bygger på att tillsammans tar vi ansvar och skapar förtroende. Vi är måna om att våra medarbetare i Ale mår bra och erbjuder där det är möjligt flexibel arbetstid, friskvårdsbidrag samt förmånliga kollektivavtal. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: https://ale.se/om-kommunen/jobba-i-ale-kommun.html Tillsammans skapar vi möjligheter, här finns en plats för alla och vi har nära till varandra. Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta rekryteringsansvarig för hantering av din ansökan.För att underlätta rekryteringsarbetet ber vi dig att bifoga relevanta intyg och betyg för tjänsten du söker samt vid eventuell intervju ha möjlighet att uppvisa giltig ID-handling. Vi har endast möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via Varbi.Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: Jobba i Ale kommun | Ale kommunInför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Dina personuppgifter behandlas i Varbi under rekryteringsprocessen och i den utsträckning detta är nödvändigt för att uppfylla lagstiftningen. Ansökan raderas 24 månader efter avslutande av rekrytering. Om du har ett Varbi-konto kan du använda redigeringen av din profil för att radera, ladda upp och redigera information. Kontakta annars Ale kommun.Vi vill upplysa om att din ansökan är en offentlig handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen.

title: People Business Partner
description: E.ON is one of Europe's largest operators of energy networks and infrastructure and a provider of innovative energy solutions. Our employees are constantly working to digitise the energy world, achieve net zero and connect everyone to good energy. To achieve this, we are focusing our actions on sustainability, digitalisation and growth. We strongly believe that differences make us stronger and welcome all people into our inclusive and diverse culture.Inom E.ON Energiinfrastruktur skapar vi energilösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder och samhället. Nu välkomnar vi en People Business Partner som vill arbeta nära vår fjärrvärmeverksamhet. Du blir en del av vårt People-team och ingår också i ett större sammanhang med People Business Partners i andra E.ON-bolag och centrala specialistfunktioner. Din rollSom People Business Partner är du en nära partner till chefer och lokala ledningsgrupper och omsätter verksamhetens behov i konkreta HR-insatser. Rollen förenar strategiskt och taktiskt arbete med chefsstöd i vardagen.Du vägleder i frågor som rör organisationsutveckling, förändring, bemanning och kompetensförsörjning. Du stöttar också chefer i arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och komplexa personalärenden samt förbereder och genomför facklig samverkan och MBL-förhandlingar. Tillsammans med chefer och HSE arbetar du för en trygg och hälsosam arbetsmiljö, med fokus på bland annat organisatorisk och social arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv.Tillsammans utvecklar vi arbetssätt och beteenden som stödjer verksamhetens förflyttning. Här får du bidra med perspektiv på hur digitalisering och AI kan förenkla och utveckla People-arbetet.Du utgår från Malmö, Eftersom du stöttar verksamheter i Norrköping, Stockholm och Örebro med chefer på flera orter är resor en naturlig och återkommande del av uppdraget. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande och bred erfarenhet av kvalificerat HR-arbete nära chefer och ledningsgrupper. Du har god kunskap om svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och facklig samverkan samt erfarenhet av rehabilitering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.Du är van vid att stödja förändring och att tillsammans med chefer omsätta verksamhetens behov i prioriteringar och aktiviteter. Du använder gärna HR-data som underlag och känner dig bekväm med digitala HR-system. Du kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska och anpassar ditt stöd efter olika människor och situationer.Du förenar empati och lyhördhet med tydlighet och integritet. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Hur är det hos oss?Hos oss möter du ett hjälpsamt team där vi delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Din chef Josefina har ett inkluderande och utvecklingsorienterat ledarskap som bygger på tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlig riktning. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november kl 10.00.Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Josefina Cederberg Wallin, josefina.cederberg-wallin@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Mats Ekblom, +46 705 259188Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.seMattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO +46 730 499778

title: Planner & Scheduler
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.Employment: Temporary, 12-24 monthsLocation: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Planner & Scheduler for our Planning & Scheduling team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support planning and scheduling activities for an assigned project area.As Planner & Scheduler, you will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, Project Controls, EPCM partners, and contractors to maintain realistic and integrated schedules. You will help track progress, identify constraints and schedule risks, and provide reliable planning information to support project execution and decision-making.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Develop, update, and maintain project schedules in line with project planning standards    Support the maintenance and integration of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for your assigned area    Review EPCM and contractor schedules and identify inconsistencies, missing logic, constraints, and potential impacts    Integrate schedule information from contractors, EPCM partners, and internal stakeholders    Monitor actual progress against planned activities and support schedule updates and forecasting    Analyze schedules to identify delays, trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities    Support mitigation and recovery planning when schedule challenges arise    Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, planning workshops, and weekly and monthly reportingWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description: TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.What we’re looking for    Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.    A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.    Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.    Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.    Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.    Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.    A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.What you’ll do    Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.    Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.    Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.    Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.    Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.    Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.    Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.    Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.About your applicationPlease submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

As the face of Kentix in the Swedish market, you'll build relationships with end customers and partners, create new business opportunities and help establish Kentix as a recognized provider of physical IT security solutions.What you'll work on    Drive the commercial growth of Kentix in Sweden, taking ownership of market development and helping establish Kentix as a trusted partner for physical IT security.    Identify, engage and win new business opportunities with end customers operating mission-critical IT environments, including data centers, critical infrastructure and enterprise IT organizations.    Expand the Kentix ecosystem by collaborating with partners, consultants, system integrators and other key stakeholders across the Swedish market.    Act as the local Kentix expert and pre-sales consultant, supporting ASSA ABLOY sales teams with customer opportunities, solution specifications and the successful positioning of KentixONE.What will help you succeed    Experience in Business Development, solution sales or market development within data centers, IT infrastructure, critical infrastructure, physical security, networking, power infrastructure or related technology sectors.    An established network within the Swedish market and the ability to leverage relationships to create commercial opportunities.    Experience selling complex technical solutions to enterprise customers through direct and partner-led channels.    Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage confidently with both technical and commercial stakeholders.    Fluent Swedish and English communication skills and willingness to travel across Sweden to meet customers and partners.Why KentixKentix combines physical security, access control and infrastructure monitoring in one integrated platform designed for mission-critical IT environments. As we expand in Sweden, you'll join at a pivotal stage of our growth journey. This is an opportunity to combine the agility of a growing business with the strength of ASSA ABLOY while helping customers protect mission-critical IT environments.    Meaningful Impact – Help organizations protect critical IT infrastructure and improve operational resilience in environments where reliability is essential.    Innovative Technology – Represent KentixONE, an integrated platform that brings together physical security, access control and monitoring capabilities in a single solution.    Entrepreneurial Freedom – Take ownership of a developing market and play a direct role in shaping our growth in Sweden.    International Collaboration – Work alongside experienced Business Development colleagues across Europe while benefiting from the strength and stability of ASSA ABLOY.    Flexible Working – Work where you're closest to customers, with the flexibility and autonomy needed to succeed in a market-facing role. Ready to build a market rather than inherit one?If you're excited by the opportunity to build a market, work with innovative technology and make a direct impact on Kentix's success in Sweden, we'd like to hear from you.Apply today and help us create a safer and more open world.We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. Just set up your profile and apply here. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner at lea.rein@assaabloy.comDepending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.We are the ASSA ABLOY GroupOur people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
description: Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADAAbout the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

title: Head of Digital – Retail to Lindex, Gothenburg
description: The opportunityThis is a broad digital leadership role with responsibility for the systems and capabilities that support Lindex entire retail network. You have the opportunity to influence both operational reliability and the future development of the retail area.The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You lead a multidisciplinary organisation that includes digital leads, developers and managers.About the roleAs Head of Digital – Retail, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across the company’s retail network. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through collaboration across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.The Head of Digital – Retail holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).Key responsibilities    Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for the retail area.    Ensure stable operations and continuous improvement of point-of-sale systems, RFID solutions, the employee retail app and security gate systems.    Identify opportunities to improve retail processes, including pricing, product handling and the establishment of new retails.    Monitor system performance and lead effective incident management for business-critical retail solutions.    Coordinate digital requirements with Facilities and Properties to secure connectivity, fibre infrastructure and appropriate technical retail formats.    Balance operational stability, incremental improvements and the development of new digital capabilities.    Lead a team of developers, digital leads and managers.    Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Manegement Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.    Collaborate across the organization to align retail priorities with Lindex overall business, digital and technology direction.    Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.About youYou understand the complexity of retail operations and recognise how even small changes in technology can have a significant operational impact. You combine curiosity about retail with sound judgement, structured prioritisation and the ability to turn business needs into workable digital solutions. You provide clarity across organisational boundaries and maintain a strong focus on stability, performance and continuous improvement.To succeed in the role, you need:    A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.    Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.    Extensive leadership experience, including leading managers, employees or cross-functional teams.    Experience translating business strategy and operational needs into digital priorities, capabilities and execution.    Experience leading digital products, platforms, data, automation, agile delivery, objectives and key results, and backlog prioritisation.    Experience driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.    Strong communication skills and fluency in English.It is an advantage if you have:    Experience from retail and a strong understanding of day-to-day retail operations.    Experience with point-of-sale systems, RFID technology, retail applications or other retail-related platforms.    Experience with monitoring, incident management and business-critical technical infrastructure.    Experience leading across reporting lines and building trust with business and digital stakeholders.    Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.Location and ApplicationThe position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. title: Produktspecialist - Underjordsutrustning
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Produktspecialist - Underjordsutrustning Följ med oss när vi accelererar transformationen! Som Produktspecialist – Underjordsutrustning hos Epiroc får du en nyckelroll i att stötta våra kunder och interna serviceteam med djup teknisk kompetens inom underjordsutrustning. Du är en senior teknisk rådgivare som bidrar till säkra, effektiva och hållbara lösningar — och gör verklig skillnad där det händer. Bli en del av vårt team Du blir en del av Epirocs serviceverksamhet, där säkerhet, samarbete och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och stöttar varandra i vardagen, med målet att alltid leverera högsta kvalitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer. Hos oss är du en viktig representant för Epirocs varumärke och våra värderingar: Innovation, Samarbete och Engagemang. Ditt uppdrag I rollen som Produktspecialist arbetar du både strategiskt och operativt. Du är en central kompetensresurs som kombinerar tekniskt arbete i fält med rådgivning, utbildning och problemlösning. Ditt uppdrag innebär bland annat att: •    Agera senior teknisk rådgivare gentemot kunder och interna servicetekniker•    Utföra service, reparationer, felsökning och uppstarter av underjordsutrustning•    Genomföra praktiska utbildningar för nyanställda och kunder•    Säkerställa att arbete utförs säkert genom riskanalyser och efterlevnad av Epirocs regelverk•    Ha en löpande och proaktiv kunddialog genom hela arbetsprocessen•    Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och verksamhet•    Dokumentera arbeten, rapportera tid och material samt vid behov bistå med prisestimat Du arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor och har en viktig roll i att skapa förtroende och långsiktigt kundvärde. Din profilDu är en trygg, lösningsorienterad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll där du får ta ansvar och dela med dig av din kunskap. Säkerhet är en självklar del av ditt arbetssätt, och du har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera tydligt. Vi ser gärna att du har: •    Stark teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet av service och felsökning av underjords utrustning•    Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och samtidigt ge stöd och rådgivning i mer komplexa ärenden•    Ett strukturerat och kundfokuserat arbetssätt med god kommunikationsförmåga•    God förståelse i svenska och engelska Erfarenhet av utbildning, teknisk support eller arbete i kundnära miljö är meriterande. Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter. Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc: •    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus Placering och resorDenna tjänst är placerad i Slagsta. Resor förekommer främst i Stockholmsområdet, men det kan även förekomma resor till andra orter. Ansökan och kontaktinformationVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 29 november 2026: Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

description: We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments team in Stockholm. We're a small team that owns everything that happens when someone pays Epidemic Sound: checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, refunds, tax, and payment provider integrations happens through systems we build and run. We work in short iterations where our changes bring immediate customer value.Our main initiative is a new purchase platform in Go: a greenfield subscription domain, built alongside today's system, including a seamless migration of live paying customers onto our new system. You'll help set and implement this technical direction.We’re a small and collaborative team that owns services end to end, from domain model to Terraform, on-call included. You'll work closely with Product, Finance, and the web teams whose checkout journeys sit on our APIs. AI is part of our daily toolchain, which puts more weight on judgement: we read as much code as we write.Your key responsibilities include    Own payment and subscription services end to end: design, build, deploy and monitor them.        Build the next generation of our purchase platform in Go, and move live subscriptions onto it safely.        Build and maintain our payment provider integrations, including the compliance-heavy parts like 3DS and SCA.        Work in the customer-facing purchase flow in our web codebase (TypeScript) when needed.Requirements    Several years building and running backend services in production, ideally in a space where correctness mattered more than shipping speed.        Strong in Go or Python, and happy to get productive in the other. Our services are built in both.        Good in SQL and relational data modelling. We use Postgres.        Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud, and comfortable owning your own infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform).        Enough TypeScript and React to make changes in a shared frontend codebase, or a real interest in picking it up.        Experience with payments, or a clear interest in it: subscriptions, billing, provider integrations, reconciliation, etc.It would also be music to our ears if you have    Migrated a billing or payment platform with live customers on it.        Worked with PSPs, card networks, 3DS and SCA, or inside PCI scope.        Experience building event-driven services using Pub/Sub or a comparable messaging system.        Practical experience applying AI coding agents in production, and sound judgement about when to rely on them.

title: Inventory Planner
description: Company DescriptionIn Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers. We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people. Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability. Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets. IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen. About the role  We are now looking for an Inventory Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy supports availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move safely, reliably and efficiently from supplier to distribution centre and onwards into the IKEA Food experience. The role works closely with Category, suppliers, service providers, distribution centres and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, forecasts, lead times and distribution to take clear inventory actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value. In this role you will:     Own supplier-to-DC and/or DC-DC inbound availability for assigned products, DCs and markets.     Maintain accurate inventory and inbound flow execution, including orders, ERP corrections and physical-flow corrections.     Act on daily inventory corrections, inbound order handling, flow bookings and deviations within agreed parameters.     Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and lead-time adherence when planning and following up the inbound flow.     Secure supplier and logistics-service-provider execution through confirmations, holiday planning, inbound coordination and invoice follow-up.     Manage deviations related to quality, blocked goods, shelf life, shortages and inventory accuracy with timely action and escalation.     Improve ways of working together with suppliers, service providers, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders. We are looking for someone who:     Has experience from supply-chain operations, inventory-, supply planning, inbound logistics or DC flow.     Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management and planning systems.     Uses operational KPIs, inventory data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.     Understands availability at lowest cost, freshness, quality and inventory-accuracy risks, and knows when to act or escalate.     Communicates well across suppliers, logistics service providers and internal teams.     Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the inbound goods flow reliable every day. Reliable availability depends on many small inventory and inbound flow decisions done right, every day. As Inventory Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, compliance, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn supplier, inventory and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets. As part of your application, we ask you to rank the Food roles you apply for in order of preference. This helps us better understand your aspirations and supports a fair and efficient matching process across opportunities.For questions about the role, please contact Business Development Managers Irina Kärnsund via, irina.karnsund@inter.ikea.comWe look forward to receiving your application by the 17th of November, 2026.If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process contact People & Culture Specialists Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Quality Laboratory Coordinator
description: BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!British American Tobacco Sweden has an exciting opportunity for a Quality Laboratory Coordinator in Malmö.The Quality Laboratory Coordinator leads and oversees the day-to-day operations of the factory Quality Laboratory, ensuring accurate, reliable, and timely testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products in compliance with BAT Quality standards, legal requirements, and regulatory expectations.As the laboratory's technical lead, the role drives excellence through robust analytical practices, equipment reliability, data integrity, and capability development. The Quality Laboratory Coordinator supports factory decision-making through accurate quality data, ensures laboratory compliance, and drives continuous improvement across laboratory operations and performance.Your key responsibilities will include:    Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6-8 laboratory professionals, ensuring strong technical capability, engagement, and performance.    Manage day-to-day laboratory operations to ensure timely testing and release of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.    Ensure the accuracy, reliability, integrity, and timely delivery of all laboratory testing results.    Maintain compliance with BAT Quality standards, GMP, HACCP, local regulatory requirements, and applicable quality management systems.    Own and maintain laboratory systems, including SOPs, test methods, equipment calibration, validation activities, and documentation control.    Ensure data integrity, traceability, and proper documentation of all laboratory activities, testing records, and quality results.    Lead investigations into quality issues, OOS (Out of Specification) results, and laboratory deviations, implementing effective RCA and CAPA actions.    Support factory performance through quality data analysis, reporting, NCP coordination, New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, and IWS Quality Pillar initiatives.    Comply and implement activities in accordance with the rules of laws and regulations relating to environmental protection, safety at work and fire protection, and internal EHS or Sustainability standards and procedures. What are we looking for?    2-4+ years of experience in Quality Control laboratory operations within a manufacturing environment.    Previous experience leading teams and coordinating laboratory workloads in a fast-paced operational setting.    Experience managing OOS investigations, quality deviations, audit preparation, and regulatory inspections.    Proven experience in laboratory method validation, equipment qualification, calibration programs, and quality system management.    Strong knowledge of analytical testing techniques, including physical, chemical, and/or microbiological analysis.    Solid understanding of GMP, HACCP, ISO standards, laboratory compliance requirements, and data integrity principles.    Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA management, structured problem-solving methodologies, sampling plans, and statistical quality tools.    Technical qualification or degree in a scientific or technical discipline, with GMP, HACCP, or Laboratory Quality certification required; ISO 17025 and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt knowledge or certification preferred.What we offer you?    We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)    Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives    Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.    You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills    We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changesWHY JOIN BAT?In BAT Sweden we strive to create a smokeless reality on a day-to-day basis. If you wonder how we are getting there, please take a look at the OMNI report – a comprehensive study done to analyse the current market trends in tobacco harm reduction.We're one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.We see the career breaks as opportunities, not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

title: Product Manager MEKO Denmark  – Heavy Commercial Vehicles
description: ArbetsbeskrivningDo you have a strong background in heavy commercial vehicles, spare parts or technical aftermarket operations? Are you interested in developing your career within product management while working in an international organization?This could be an opportunity to take the next step.MEKO is looking for a Product Manager to support the continued expansion of its Commercial Vehicle Division under its FTZ brand in Denmark.You will contribute to the development of product groups within trucks, trailers and buses, combining your technical industry knowledge with practical product management and commercial coordination.We welcome candidates from both Denmark and Southern Sweden. Previous experience as a Product Manager is valuable but not essential. What matters most is your understanding of commercial vehicles and the motivation to develop within a growing business.Your responsibilitiesAs Product Manager, you will be part of MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division and work closely with the Danish FTZ Truck & Trailer organization.You will support the development of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, helping ensure the right assortment, pricing and product information are available to meet customer needs and commercial objectives.Your responsibilities will include:•    Identifying and supporting new product launches and assortment development initiatives.•    Preparing sourcing requirements and request-for-quotation material, as well as evaluating products together with colleagues in other MEKO markets.•    Coordinating product introductions, replacements and phase-outs.•    Managing product data and maintaining information in catalogues and PIM systems.•    Monitoring competitor offerings and contributing to pricing and assortment decisions.•    Following up on product performance, price levels, returns, obsolescence and opportunities for assortment improvements.•    Providing technical product knowledge and supporting the sales organization in product-related matters.•    Working with suppliers, category management, logistics and other internal stakeholders to maintain a competitive product offering.The position combines day-to-day operational responsibilities with opportunities to participate in broader commercial and category management activities.You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles in Denmark and colleagues within the wider MEKO CV organization. Strategic category direction and additional support are provided by the responsible Group Category Manager.This is an individual contributor role without personnel responsibility.Din ProfilYour profileWe are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical and practical side of the heavy commercial vehicle industry.You might currently be working as a Spare Parts Specialist, Parts Manager, Technical Sales Representative, Product Specialist, Workshop Coordinator or Product Manager. Your current title is less important than your experience and knowledge.A background from truck and trailer workshops, spare parts distribution, fleet maintenance, agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may be relevant.We believe you bring:•    Strong knowledge of commercial vehicles, components, spare parts and their applications.•    Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work.•    Good computer skills and the ability to work in a structured way with product information.•    An interest in developing analytical, commercial and product management skills.•    Initiative, curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with others.•    Good communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.It is advantageous if you also have:•    Previous experience in product management, assortment development or technical purchasing.•    Experience with Excel, ERP or PIM systems.•    Experience analyzing product information, sales data or market developments.•    Danish language skills or knowledge of other Nordic languages.•    A post-secondary technical education.Your understanding of trucks, trailers and heavy-duty components, combined with your motivation and willingness to learn, will be central to your success.Om företagetAbout MEKOMEKO is Northern Europe's largest player in the automotive aftermarket, with approximately 600 stores, 20,000 workshop customers and 4,600 workshops across eight countries, operating through strong brands such as Mekonomen, MECA and FTZ.The Group drives development in digitalization, AI and logistics, offering smart and sustainable solutions for vehicle service and spare parts. MEKO's vision is to enable mobility – today, tomorrow and in the future.In Denmark, MEKO operates through FTZ, a well-established name in the Danish automotive aftermarket. The Commercial Vehicle Division is an expanding business area with a focus on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications.As part of the team, you will work in a dynamic international environment with experienced technical and commercial colleagues, contributing to the development of a business with strong growth ambitions.Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.KontaktuppgifterContactIn this recruitment, MEKO Danmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.We look forward to your application!

title: Product Manager – Heavy Commercial Vehicles
description: ArbetsbeskrivningFTZ | Rørup, DenmarkJoin FTZ and help develop our growing Heavy Commercial Vehicles businessFTZ is looking for a Product Manager to strengthen our expanding Commercial Vehicle Division in Denmark. In this role, you will work with product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, including trucks, trailers and buses, and contribute to developing an attractive and competitive product offering for the Danish aftermarket.We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of commercial vehicles and their components, combined with an interest in product management and commercial development. Whether your background is in product management, spare parts, technical sales or workshop operations, your industry knowledge and motivation could make you the right person for this opportunity.You will join a growing business area where you can make a real impact, working closely with experienced colleagues both locally and across the MEKO Group.Your responsibilitiesAs Product Manager at FTZ, you will work within MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division, supporting the development and management of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles.Based on sales and profitability objectives, you will collaborate with colleagues to ensure that the right product range, competitive pricing and accurate product information are in place, while maintaining close dialogue with suppliers and internal stakeholders.Your responsibilities will include:•    Identifying, initiating and supporting projects for the launch of new products.•    Preparing request-for-quotation material and product specifications for sourcing, and evaluating products in cooperation with colleagues across MEKO countries.•    Managing product phase-in and phase-out activities.•    Maintaining and administering product information in catalogues and PIM systems.•    Monitoring competitors and supporting pricing activities.•    Following up on product assortments, price levels, product performance and relevant actions related to obsolescence, returns and assortment changes.•    Acting as a product expert within your areas and supporting the sales organization with technical knowledge.•    Contributing to the development of an attractive and competitive product offering for customers.This is a broad, hands-on role combining operational product management with opportunities to contribute to commercial development. You will have regular contact with suppliers, sales teams, product colleagues and logistics functions.You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles and the Group Category Manager, who provides strategic category direction and support. The position does not include personnel management.Din ProfilYour profileYour understanding of Heavy Commercial Vehicles and their components is the most important qualification for this position.We are looking for someone with relevant experience from trucks, trailers, buses or a closely related heavy-duty industry. You may currently work in product management, spare parts, technical sales, workshop operations, parts distribution or a similar role. Experience from agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may also be relevant.To succeed in the role, we believe you have:•    Solid practical knowledge of commercial vehicles, their components and applications.•    Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work •    Good computer literacy and the willingness to work extensively with digital product information and systems.•    A structured, service-minded and proactive approach to your work.•    An interest in product development, assortment management and commercial opportunities.•    Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and countries.•    Fluency in English, both spoken and written.The following qualifications are considered advantages rather than requirements:•    Previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Specialist or Category Manager.•    Experience with Excel, ERP systems such as AX or Enterprise, or Product Information Management (PIM).•    Strong analytical skills and experience working with product or sales data.•    Danish or other Nordic language skills.•    Post-secondary technical education.What matters is your technical understanding, your motivation and your willingness to develop your product management capabilities.Om företagetAbout FTZFTZ is one of Denmark's leading automotive aftermarket distributors, supplying spare parts, tools and solutions to professional workshops and automotive businesses.As part of the MEKO Group, FTZ combines its strong position in Denmark with the expertise, purchasing capabilities and international network of one of Northern Europe's leading automotive aftermarket groups.The Commercial Vehicle Division is a growing business area focused on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications. You will join an organization with strong technical and commercial competence, close cooperation across countries and opportunities to contribute to the continued expansion of the business.MEKO operates across eight European countries through established brands, including FTZ, Mekonomen and MECA. The Group drives development in digitalization, logistics and sustainable mobility solutions, with a vision to enable mobility today, tomorrow and in the future.Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.KontaktuppgifterIn this recruitment, FTZ Denmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.We look forward to your application!
