We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

title: Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist
description: EinleitungstextThe Microelectronics Design Center (DZ) of the Department of Information Technologies and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET) is a technical support group providing design tools, know-how and licenses for ASIC, FPGA, Embedded Systems and PCB design for research and teaching . This includes consulting, project planning, reviewing of active projects as well as participation in projects. To lead the area of Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design we are seeking a Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist starting 1st of January 2027 or by mutual agreement.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will be part of an experienced team and be the expert for analog/mixed-signal in the DZ.You will own the analog/mixed-signal area of the IC design infrastructure and further develop it with the aim to provide support to researchers and students.You will support design flows covering all aspects of IC design with a strong focus on analog/mixed-signal design flows using the latest tools from Cadence Design System, Synopsys, Mentor Graphics and open-source tools.You will interact with students and researchers to help them with their IC design related questions, chip finishing and submission of ICs to fabrication through MPW and foundry contacts.You will also be asked to develop, adapt and maintain common building blocks for mixed-signal IC chips as well as the development of larger mixed-signal ICs.As part of a team supporting research and teaching at ETH Zurich, you will frequently be challenged to develop solutions for systems that stretch the boundaries of conventional approaches.You will be asked to help researchers and students through design reviews.You will also develop and deliver targeted training modules and hands-on laboratory sessions for students and researchers in these areas.In addition, you will contribute to the group's outreach and visibility by supporting its web presence and preparing periodic activity reports.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an experienced IC designer with strong expertise in analog/mixed-signal design, motivated to work in an environment where creative technical problem-solving supports researchers and students. Given the level and breadth of the technical challenges involved, a PhD in Electrical or Computer Engineering is preferred. Candidates should bring at least 5 years of IC design experience, gained in industry or at a qualified research institution, including hands-on familiarity with tape-out procedures. A track record of multiple successful analog/mixed-signal tape-outs across a range of technology nodes, including advanced ones such as 22nm and FinFET, is required, as is experience leading chip tape-out projects. Proficiency with UNIX, scripting languages, and IC design tools from major EDA vendors is also required. Good written and spoken English is essential for technical collaboration in a multicultural environment. Experience organizing technical training courses and undergraduate laboratory activities is highly desirable. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and technical skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences and is comfortable taking on a leading and senior technical role within the team.Wir bietenWe are a small support team of four permanent employees, and are looking forward to add a fifth member to the team. As a support group we expect you to be present mostly in the office to interact with students and research staff, however we can accommodate some home office hours per week as long as it aligns with the rest of the group. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our team. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. If you are interested in this role but your past experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:A letter of motivationCVDiplomasCertificates of employmentThe application deadline is 30 November 2026.Further information about Microelectronics Design Center can be found on our Website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Frank K. Gürkaynak, +41 44 632 2726 or kgf@iis.ee.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.For recruitment services the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

title: Lab Manager and Experimental Technical Support Staff
description: EinleitungstextAt the IDEAL Lab, we develop algorithms and computational models that design physical hardware and validate those designs via physical experiments. We have a growing physical footprint that includes 3D printers, a custom foam cutter, several robotic arms (UR5e), and a variety of small mechatronic test rigs that change depending on the project. We also have a large teaching profile with ~20-30 Bachelor's and Master's students joining the lab each semester for various projects, a subset of which involve robotics or mechatronics-related experiments.ProjekthintergrundWe are looking for a part-time technical staff member to act as a Lab Manager and/or coordinating technician, depending on the skillset of the person. The specific roles and responsibilities of this person — and the amount of time/effort required from them — would depend on what they could do based on their experience or desire for future training/growth. The core task would be basic lab operations and safety, as mentioned below — anticipated ~20% time — with an optional/desired role for additional time being the engineering and student support — initially anticipated at 20% time, however, this has the option to grow in the future depending on the skills, usefulness, and desires of the specific candidate.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungBasic Lab Operations and Safety (~20% time):Act as the General Safety Representative for the lab. Train incoming students/staff on safety rules and how to use shared equipment (trainings occur 3-4 times per year for 1-2 hours). Update the safety concept, e.g., once per year or as needed.Keep the lab spaces operational, such as managing inventory, handling purchase requests for supplies, retrieving packages as needed, and working with students to ensure workstations are kept clean and organized. Coordinate the once-a-year lab cleaning day with staff.Coordinate with staff and students on the maintenance and use of shared equipment such as the 3D printers, robots, and hand tools, as well as repairs when things break, as per the safety concept. This can include delegating tasks to existing staff if appropriate.Act as a point of contact for student questions about where equipment or supplies are located in the lab space. Generally share personal knowledge and maintain personal relationships. Guide students toward other ETH resources (like other technical workshops or facilities) outside of our immediate lab’s perimeter when they have specific questions/needs (e.g., ETH TechPool, off-site laser cutters, Instron machines, etc.).Attend any occasional lab operational meetings with the PI and other staff, or lab retreats as desired, although not recurring lab meetings (unless desired).Engineering and Student Support (~20% time):Where appropriate, support research goals by helping or consulting with students and staff to debug and run physical experiments they have planned. This could include helping them build or debug necessary rigs or platforms for various research projects, automating existing procedures from past research projects to make them easier to extend in the future, or building working knowledge of the lab’s robotic infrastructure to more quickly onboard new student projects. This depends on the specific hands-on skills of the individual candidate, and also the project needs, as existing students/staff will be the ones largely responsible for setting up and maintaining their own infrastructure.Support research goals by coordinating with outside/external partners, for example, ETH TechPool, outside contractors, researchers at other labs or institutions, etc. to deliver or maintain necessary experimental equipment.Maintain the operation of a few lab demos for occasional visitors.Assist, as requested, Ph.D. students and Post-Docs with transitioning their student projects between semesters, e.g., from one set of Thesis students to another, in cases where the project has a physical experiment setup that uses the lab space. For example, by helping create or review documentation, answering questions that new students may have, demonstrating the use of an existing test setup, or helping staff store or dismantle projects that are no longer needed.Ihr ProfilA practical background (e.g., FH, B.Sc., M.Sc. degree) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics or a related field.Hands-on expertise with 3D printing, small robotics (like UR5e), and basic electronics/sensors or mechatronic systems.You like working with and mentoring students, and helping them pursue varied and creative projects that ensure both safety and pragmatism/flexibility.Organized, practical, team player, and comfortable with enforcing lab safety rules and making sure students/staff clean up after themselves.An ideal candidate would feel comfortable working with small hand tools, small robotic cobots (e.g., UR5e and associated ROS/ROS2 environments), and developing small sensor packages/electronic setups necessary for measuring device performance (e.g., RPMs, distances moved, thrusts/forces, etc.). The candidate would also be comfortable looking at engineering drawings provided by outside partners, such as ETH TechPool or similar.Wir bietenWorld-class research infrastructure and excellent working conditions guided by our common understanding of a supportive shared work cultureA role that makes an impact: Become part of ETH Zurich and an international academic environment that supports your professional development and contributes to societal progress through research and teaching.  You will be fully integrated into both the chair's team and the department's tecnicians team. Regular professional and personal exchange, as well as open and supportive collaboration, provide you with a strong network in your daily work.  We offer flexible working hours that – as far as operational requirements allow – accommodate different personal and family needs.  ETH Zurich offers a wide range of courses and professional development opportunities.  Benefits such as public transport passes and car sharing, a wide sports program through ASVZ, childcare, etc.  Attractive pension benefits through the PUBLICA pension fund.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to your online application with the following documents:Cover letterResumeCertificates of employmentFurther information about the Artificial Intelligence in Engineering Design Lab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Mrs Martina Koch, Adm. Assistant, 044 632 45 16 or martikoc@ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.For recruitment services the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

title: Semiconductor Metrology & Quality Control Technician – 100%
description: Are you the person who enjoy precise, hands-on work with wafers and chips in a cleanroom, and operating metrology equipment such as optical microscopes, die-sorting, SEM? At Lightium, we're building the next generation of thin-film lithium niobate photonic integrated circuits to help AI infrastructure run faster. As we move from development toward volume production, we're looking for a Metrology & Quality Control Technician to own the measurement, inspection and sorting of our wafers and chips, and to make sure every part that leaves Lightium is exactly what our customers expect. Position Summary As part of our Operations team, you will be the day-to-day responsible for metrology and quality control, as well as die sorting and packaging in our semiconductor cleanroom. You will characterize wafers and chips with a broad set of metrology tools (including optical microscopes, SEM), run incoming and outgoing inspection, operate the pick-and-place machine for die sorting and package and document our products with full traceability. You will work closely with our process, design and test engineers, as well as with fab partners and suppliers. Precision and reliable execution are at the core of the job, and your experience will help shape the way we measure, inspect and release our products as we scale. Key Responsibilities Metrology: Perform wafer- and chip-level measurements using SEM, stylus profilometer, optical and confocal microscopes, and ellipsometer (e.g., film thickness, critical dimensions, etch depth and step height, surface topography and defects). Set up and maintain measurement recipes, keep tools calibrated and in good working condition, and coordinate with service providers when needed.  Sorting & Packaging: Sort chips and dies by hand using manual and vacuum tweezers, as well as operate our pick & place machine to sort dies from singulated wafers on tape to industry-standards shipping containers such as GelPak, waffle pack, JEDEC tray. Handle wafer taping, die marking, final sorting, packaging and sealing in vacuum bags. Data & Reporting: Record, analyze and report measurement results in a clear and traceable way, compliant with our data-stack and data ingestion processes. Promptly flag out-of-spec results and deviations to engineering, support root-cause investigations, and help trend key parameters over time. Incoming Quality Control: Inspect incoming wafers, chips and critical materials from fab partners and suppliers against specifications, complete goods acceptance documentation, and handle nonconforming material in coordination with internal stakeholders. Outgoing Quality Control: Perform final visual and dimensional inspection of chips and wafers before shipment, prepare Certificates of Conformance (CoC) and inspection reports for customers, and ensure that packaging meets our quality standards. Traceability: Ensure full traceability of every wafer and chip through consistent labeling and identification, keep inventory and traceability records accurate in our ERP, PLM system for data traceability, and help maintain the same standards across our R&D and production lines. Procedures & Improvement: Contribute to writing and updating work instructions and inspection and measurement procedures as part of our growing quality management system, and suggest practical improvements based on your daily work, including suggestions for engineers for better automations and improvements of our MES system.  What you’ll bring Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in metrology and quality control in semiconductor, photonics, MEMS or a related micro- and nanofabrication environment such as watch industry and medical instruments. Technical education such as an EFZ apprenticeship (e.g., Mikrotechnologe/in, Physiklaborant/in), a higher technical diploma, or an FH degree in a related field. Metrology Know-how: Hands-on operation of SEM, profilometry, optical and confocal microscopy, ellipsometry, as well as pick-and-place machine for die sorting. Solid experience and dexterity with manual handling of wafers and chips with tweezers. Solid understanding of inspection criteria for wafers and dies. Cleanroom Experience: Proven experience working in ISO 5 / ISO 6 cleanrooms and gray-rooms, operating cleanroom equipment ensuring compliance with cleanroom requirements, as well as preventive and regular maintenance and calibration of tools. Precision & Work Ethic: Meticulous, reliable and hardworking. You take pride in getting things right the first time and in documenting your work so others can trust your results. Quality Mindset: Familiarity with quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001), nonconformance handling and traceability. Experience preparing CoCs or inspection reports is a plus. Tools: Comfortable with Microsoft 365, especially Excel for data analysis. Experience with ERP and PLM systems as well as automation and MES is a plus. Interested in using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work. Language Skills: Good English is preferred. German or French or Italian is a plus.

title: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)
description: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)Your rôleAs Healthcare Patent Counsel, you will shape the U.S. and global intellectual property strategy for pharmaceutical development projects and commercial products, with a particular focus on digital health and integrated healthcare solutions. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Metallurgy Scientist (m/f/d)---Metallurgy Scientist (m/f/d)============================ Novelis est animé par la volonté de façonner ensemble un monde durable.   En tant que leader mondial de produits et services innovants et le plus grand recycleur d'aluminium au monde d'aluminium, nous travaillons en partenariat avec des clients des secteurs de l'automobile, de l’aéronautique, des canettes et des spécialités pour fournir des solutions qui améliorent les avantages de l'aluminium léger.   Nous disposons d'un réseau coordonné d'opérations de laminage et de recyclage techniquement sophistiquées sur 29 sites dans 9 pays d'Amérique du Nord, d'Amérique du Sud, d'Europe et d'Asie, avec 12,750 employés dans le monde. Le siège se situe à Atlanta, aux États\-Unis.    Nous comptons parmi nos clients certaines des marques les plus importantes et les plus connues au monde, notamment Coca\-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, et d'autres. En outre, Novelis est à la pointe de l'industrie grâce à ses efforts en matière de durabilité et de recyclage.   Participez à notre mission de créer un monde durable et commencez dès que possible à travailler sur notre site de   **Sierre** , en Suisse.  Metallurgy Scientist (m/f/d)============================Notre centre de recherche et de technologie situé à Sierre, dans le canton du Valais (Suisse), recherche un métallurgiste possédant des compétences dans le développement d'alliages automobiles (séries 5xxx et 6xxx) ainsi que dans la recherche fondamentale. Vous participerez au développement des futures générations de produits en aluminium pour l’automobile et à l’amélioration continue des procédés de fabrication déployés au sein du réseau mondial des usines Novelis.  **Vos responsabilités:*** Diriger des projets stratégiques de développement de nouveaux produits en aluminium laminé pour le secteur automobile, en mettant l’accent sur la résistance mécanique, les performances au crash, la formabilité et la durabilité des alliages.  * Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes procédés, développement et commerciales, pour définir des produits à forte valeur ajoutée répondant aux besoins du marché.  * Établir des collaborations avec des universités et des consortiums internationaux afin d’accélérer l’innovation et le développement de solutions durables.  * Fournir une expertise technique sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de production de l’aluminium, notamment dans les domaines du laminage à chaud, du laminage à froid et de la finition, afin de soutenir les activités de production.    **Comment nous convaincre:*** Master ou doctorat en science des matériaux, métallurgie ou dans un domaine connexe ; une expérience professionnelle pertinente est un atout.  Solide expertise en métallurgie et en caractérisation des matériaux.  * Expérience dans le domaine de l’aluminium et de ses procédés de fabrication ; une expérience dans le secteur automobile est un atout.  * Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.  * Esprit d’équipe dynamique, flexible et innovant, capable d’apprendre rapidement et d’évoluer avec aisance dans des environnements multiculturels.  * Maîtrise de l’anglais ; la maîtrise du français ou de l’allemand est un atout.  Merci de postuler avant le 20 novembre 2026\.\-\-\-\-\-Our Research \& Technology Center in Sierre, Valais, Switzerland, is seeking a Metallurgy Scientist with expertise in automotive alloy design (5xxx and 6xxx) and fundamental research. You will help address today’s challenges and unlock new opportunities for aluminium sheet in vehicle applications and processing of aluminium in our global plant network.  **Your responsabilities:*** Lead projects to develop new rolled aluminium products for the automotive industry, focusing on high strength, crash performance, formability, and sustainable alloy design.  * Collaborate closely with application engineering, development, and commercial teams to define viable product specifications and identify business opportunities.  * Partner with universities and global working groups to develop innovative, long\-term material solutions for new design concepts.  * Provide project\-based expertise in aluminium processing, including hot rolling, cold rolling, and finishing, to support operations.    **How to convince us:*** . or Ph.D. in materials science, metallurgy, or a related field; relevant work experience is a plus.  * Strong expertise in metallurgy and material characterization.  * Experience with aluminium and its manufacturing processes; automotive experience is an advantage.  * Strong project management skills and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across the organization.  * A dynamic, flexible, and innovative team player who learns quickly and thrives in multicultural environments.  * Fluent in English; French or is an advantage.   Please apply before 20th November, 2026\. ![Novelis Switzerland SA]()* Rte des Laminoirs 15 3960 Sierre** ![Novelis Switzerland SA]()* Rte des Laminoirs 15 3960 Sierre**jid761c3a7jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

description: Plant Controller \- 100%**Location:** Canton of Bern, Switzerland  **Industry:** Manufacturing / Production  **Languages:** Business\-level German and English required; Swiss German is an advantageAbout the opportunityAre you a finance professional who enjoys understanding how a business operates, investigating the details behind the numbers and contributing to better commercial decisions?Our client, an international manufacturing company based in the Canton of Bern, is looking for a **Plant Controller** to join its finance team. This is an opportunity for someone with strong accounting fundamentals and an interest in production controlling who wants to develop into a broader finance leadership role.You will work closely with the current manager during a structured handover, learning the plant’s financial processes, systems and business operations.Why join?* **Develop your career:** Build towards a senior controlling or finance management position, with potential for progression as you grow into the role.* **Learn directly from an experienced manager:** Benefit from a structured handover and the opportunity to develop a thorough understanding of the business.* **Gain broad exposure:** Work across finance, accounting and production, developing both technical and commercial expertise.Your responsibilities* Support the financial and production\-controlling activities of the manufacturing site.* Analyse production costs and investigate variances, pricing questions and other financial issues.* Develop an understanding of the plant’s financial processes and how they connect with its production activities.* Work with financial systems and tools, learning how different processes and modules interact.* Collaborate with colleagues across finance and operations to understand business performance and resolve issues.* Take ownership of financial questions, investigate the underlying details and propose practical solutions.* Work closely with the current manager during the handover and gradually assume broader responsibilities.Your profile* Experience in **production or plant controlling** within a Swiss accounting qualification** is advantageous. Candidates working towards a qualification are also encouraged to apply.* Familiarity with SAP or another ERP system.* **German and English language skills are required. Swiss German is an advantage.*** An analytical and commercially minded approach, combined with attention to detail.* Curiosity, initiative and the confidence to ask questions and investigate unfamiliar topics.* Flexibility and motivation to learn, take ownership and grow within the business.Interested?If you are looking for a role where you can combine your accounting knowledge with commercial thinking and develop your career in a manufacturing environment, we would be pleased to hear from you.Please send us your CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation.j4id10466044jm j4it1145jm j4iy26jm
